name: Hot Lunch
description: Rock out with Hot Lunch as they play their third annual Somerville Porch Fest! They'll be serving pop punk, rock, and pop classics from the 90s to now.

name: Tong
description: Tong is a house music artist known for turning everyday spaces into something a little less predictable. Blending house, minimal, and left-field grooves, his sets move between clean, driving rhythms and offbeat selections that catch people mid-conversation and pull them closer to the speakers. Rooted in a mix of late-night city energy and laid-back daytime sessions, Tong treats each set like a living room that just happens to have a better sound system. At PorchFest, expect warm grooves, subtle builds, and just enough chaos to keep things interesting. Special Guest Performance Appearances by Boston based Artists TBA.

name: Pacific Reed
description: Hi all! We are a nostalgic rock cover band out of San Diego, CA. We love playing songs that everyone forgets they know all the lyrics to. From Vance Joy, Green Day, to Talking Heads, we’re looking forward singing our hearts out with you all!

name: Fluid Exchange aka Major Threat
description: During the peak of the Covid-19 pandemic, a chance encounter on a Reddit bodybuilding forum brought together four strangers with a shared vision. With a mutual appreciation for uplifting lyrics and melodies, testosterone-boosting guitar solos, and peak male performance, Fluid Exchange aka Major Threat was born and immediately started building an energized base throughout the Florida Panhandle. Fresh off a successful stint as the backing band on Chris Daughtry’s “Man at Large/The Big Unit Tour” through South America, FE aka MT is back in the studio and putting the finishing touches on their debut album, AK Forty-Sermon.

name: Full Powered Halo
description: Full Powered Halo formed in Boston in 1993 during the post-grunge era, focusing on strong, catchy songwriting over trends. They built a loyal local following, released EPs recorded at Fort Apache, gained radio play, and opened for major acts like Matchbox 20 and The Goo Goo Dolls. They toured the nationally, eventually disbanding around 1998. A decade later, founding members regrouped with new talent, revitalizing the band’s sound and energy. Now reformed, they aim to build on their original momentum and reestablish their place in the Boston music scene.

name: Walking Towers
description: Playing a combination of rock covers and originals

name: Cheer Camp
description: Bunch of local guys playing happy covers

name: Foray
description: We’re a cover band born out of the Industry Lab coworking community. Our setlist is as diverse as our background, spanning jazz, anime soundtracks, video game themes, funk and pop hits. We play a little bit of everything to keep the energy high and the music interesting.

name: Vinyl Street & The Contemporaries a cappella
description: 5:00-5:30 - Vinyl Street is a professional a cappella group based in Somerville, MA. They have been performing in the Greater Boston area since 2007. Vinyl Street specializes in a mix of lively pop music. 5:30-6:00 - The Contemporaries

name: Baby Bowler
description: Three high school friends who love making music together, Baby Bowler plays a mix of alternative rock and covers of popular songs. With a laid-back style and a passion for performing, they’re excited to be back for their fourth year at PorchFest. Whether it’s a familiar favorite or something new, their goal is to keep the music fun and the vibes good.

name: Parker Lawrence
description: Parker will be performing the album "All Hail West Texas" by the Mountain Goats.

name: Doc Huth and the Uncouth Youth
description: Serving up unvarnished lyrical truths, Doc Huth and the Uncouth Youth will put hair on your tooth but go down smooth as vermouth. For decades this acclaimed string band has enraptured audiences of all ages with an eclectic fusion of bluegrass, folk, punk, rock, and Shrek that will have you tapping your feet, dampening your cheeks, and crying out for more!

name: East Rock Brass Band
description: We are a New Orleans brass band from New Haven, CT. We play covers of brass band tunes from New Orleans as well as originals that we made. We perform with high and contagious energy, getting the audience to dance and sing with us. We've performed in many street festivals in CT as well as big fairs such as The Big E and the Durham Fair. Our line up up percussion and live horns are the perfect way to bring a little of the New Orleans spirit and energy to the east coast.

name: House Husband
description: Folk, rock, pop, and general fun

name: Mental States
description: Freely improvised, acoustic jazz duo in which Nancy Doberman plays flute and her husband Eric plays double bass. They first played Somerville Porchfest in 2025.

name: The Gronwup Noise, Horsehands, people | please
description: The band formed in 2005 as a somewhat rare bird on the Boston rock scene. After 20 years and much lived experience the original line-up is back together. The band of Paul, Adam, Katie, and Kyle have just finished tracking their 6th album ‘No Straight Line in the Universe’. “This album feels different, like maybe our sound has finally bloomed” This new album feels like an artistic reunion by old friends who have a lot to say to each other

name: Steve Rondo
description: Steve Rondo is a Boston-based alt-indie rock songwriter blending driving guitars, atmospheric textures, and introspective storytelling. His music captures coming-of-age themes, coastal living, and the search for meaning in modern life. Known for dynamic live performances, he has headlined Brighton Music Hall and Mercury Lounge, appeared at Levitate Music Festival and 92.5 The River’s Riverfest, and opened for Dermot Kennedy. His work has been featured on Spotify’s Fresh Finds Indie and 92.5 The River, building a loyal audience across the Northeast.

name: Spats Riley
description: Borrowing her name from her father’s 70s band, Spats Riley brings biting lyrics to classic Americana in what has been dubbed “broken-hearted country blues.” Hailing from Somerville, MA, Spats has rock‘n’roll roots in the city but owes her Northern twang to an upbringing in the woods of Maine

name: Feather Weather
description: Feather Weather is an energetic Boston-based instrumental fusion band with varied musical influences ranging from Jazz, Rock, Funk, R&B and more. A five-piece band consisting of keys, drums, electric bass and two guitars, Feather Weather takes the listener on a sonic journey filled with driving riffs, odd-metered grooves and ripping solos. Layered with catchy melodies that get trapped in your head, listening to Feather Weather has been described as riding the “ear-worm express” by fans. To date, they have released a live album recorded at Sally O’Brien’s which can be found on Bandcamp. They are releasing their debut EP in Summer 2026, recorded at local renowned studio Rare Signals!

name: Sounds Like Chicken
description: Smokin' 9 piece band playing cover tunes from the 60s to now. Bring your dancing shoes!

name: Swamp Thong
description: Somerville's own DIY cover band coming to you live from 48 Cameron ave. Swamp Thong is all about connecting with our community, creating joy and resistance in music, and having fun. We're mostly beginner young adult performers that took up playing music again after years of getting caught up in the daily grind of life. We're super excited for this to be our debut performance and will be bringing you pop-punk, emo, and rock favs with some healthy grit and grunge.

name: alicia devereaux
description: a woman with a ukulele (complimentary) and a loop pedal performing pop covers. she will be living, laughing, and loving!

name: Garlic
description: Garlic is an improvisational band comprised of veteran Somerville musicians.

name: Kingfisher
description: Kingfisher is a Boston-based contra dance band, consisting of Cecilia Vacanti (fiddle) and Jeff Kaufman (piano, mandolin, drums, synths). We've applied for a block party permit to shut the street down for dancing. A few years ago our porchfest set was featured in the Globe https://www.bostonglobe.com/2023/05/13/arts/photos-somerville-porchfest-returns-with-live-performances-lots-dancing Harris Lapiroff will be calling, and we'll have a mixture of dances for experienced folks and people who've never done it before.

name: Lowden Sound
description: Funk, Rock, Pop and a little bit of everything

name: The Utahraptors
description: We're a four man rock band that's been tearing up the Boston basement and house party scene and dreaming of performing at PorchFest. Luckily our one friend we know with a porch is willing to host us, so expect a session of rock, some singalong covers, and a little bit of everything we can throw at you: heavy guitar, rumbling bass, sharp drums, and, of course, a very charismatic frontman. See you there!

name: Rothalpy
description: Rothalpy is a rock trio of graduate students and faculty at MIT AeroAstro. They perform classic rock, early 2000s, as well as some originals.

name: Little Yellow House
description: An acoustic duo playing our favorite songs in front of our little yellow house.

name: The Proper Lovers
description: The Proper Lovers fuse smoky jazz grooves with explosive rock energy—tight, unpredictable, and effortlessly cool, with the kind of tall, handsome presence that’s as striking as their sound.

name: Beft
description: Rock stew, ingredients ranging from psychedelia to alternative stuff to whatever your favorite food was growing up. We're like if the band CAKE was bad. Come listen!

name: Porchfish
description: Porchfish, aka Bob Oakes, plays old Delta Blues and folk blues and rock. With his steel guitar and deep gravelly voice, Bob plays a combination of his favorites from the masters like Son House and Bukka White as well as original songs and some odd covers from other more modern inspirations.

name: Marzipan
description: We are Marzipan, a band local to Somerville, MA! We're a group of five musicians (vocals, piano, bass, drums, and sax) that performs original bossa-style indie rock and funky covers of crowd-pleasers. We've performed at local venues like the Armory, Cafe Zing, and the Cantab Lounge. We've released a single, My My on all streaming platforms and are working towards our first album. Formed in August 2025, this will be our first porchfest as an act, though some of us have performed in Somerville Porchfest with other bands in years past.

name: SpaceBar
description: Just some guys bein dudes, and we play music too! Come drop in for some rock and indie covers

name: The Double Lives & DISCO.very
description: 2-3 pm - The Double Lives: 5 piece rock band playing creative covers and original music. 3-4pm - DISCO.very

name: Last Prisoner Project Charity Session
description: Last Prisoner Project is excited to be hosting an electronic music jam to benefit our mission as we work to free all cannabis prisoners across the United States! In an effort to help clear some space at the office, we'll be hosting all of our promo goods from the past two years (including water bottles, info postcards, rolling papers, and more) in the backyards and offering visitors the chance to take home whatever they'd like for a donation of their choice.

name: SheBoom
description: Somerville/Cambridge's only post-menopausal, Brazilian-inspired percussion and vocal ensemble performs mashups of the songs you know with a twist. All ages. Janine Fay, agogo; Lesley Bannatyne, surdo; Adria Steinberg, surdo; Julie Schneider, repique; Deb Pacini, snare/maracas; Lisa Doyle, snare, conga; Candyce Dostert, conga.

name: The nÓgs
description: Pogues Tribute!

name: Sound Advice
description: Sound Advice is a groove-rock/neo-soul band based out of Somerville, MA performing original music and tasteful spins on covers. Born from five lifelong musicians dedicated to tight rhythm and silky harmonies, you're in for a three-course meal of dirty riffs, slick bass lines, and smooth vocal hooks inspired by Snarky Puppy, Couch, Steely Dan, Amy Winehouse, Jeff Buckley, and more. They are celebrating the release of their debut EP "Sonder" recorded over a year-long period at Chillhouse Studios

name: Jade Array
description: Jade Array is a blend of indie, funk and folk. With a combination of co-written originals that reflect on different chapters of all of our individual journeys, as well as covers of classics and hidden gems, we’ve played a total of 10 shows together as a band. This will be our last performance together with all the original members, so come sing and dance with us

name: "The Functionals" and "Alright Thanks"
description: The Functionals reunite for their first public performance in 8 years. Jeff Demas, Kevin DelSignore, Ben Brown, and Jeremy Kerpka combine forces to play energetic hard rock that is influenced by the great guitar bands spanning from the 1960's through current day. Come join us for a celebration of friends, family, and loud love! Alright Thanks is an indie/surf rock band from Massachusetts that will kick things off at noon.

name: Happy Little Clouds
description: Happy Little Clouds is a genre-blurring indie rock band from Boston crafting emotionally charged, melody-forward music with a raw edge & radiant heart. Their self-described sound “grit-pop” weaves the brightness of power pop, the nerve of post-grunge & the introspection of 90s alt-rock. Proudly independent & unapologetically themselves, HLC has emerged as a compelling voice in the indie scene.

name: Margaret Carver
description: Remember the plastic recorders you played in grade school? They've grown up! Come hear the Winslow Recorder Orchestra, a collection of folks who love to get together and play music on recorders of all sizes. We play lots of early music, think Handel and Haydn, but there are plenty of familiar tunes to tap your toes to, too. Come give a listen. You'll like it!

name: The Splinters
description: The Splinters, a bluegrass and old-time string band from Massachusetts, deliver a relentless groove to accompany their tight vocal harmonies. Tom Pritchard (fiddle) brings the heat with his fiddle playing. J Johnson (mandolin) adds a jazzy flair to his breaks. Chris Reckling (guitar) picks solid rhythm and punchy leads on top of Garrett Wallace’s grooving bass fiddle. Max Petersen (banjo) adds fire and drive to complete a classic bluegrass sound. A Splinters set veers from straight ahead bluegrass to re-imagined old-time fiddle tunes and back, with the occasional detour into a modern song.

name: Good June
description: Have you been looking for a new Alternative Emo band to fill the gaping hole in your heart that has been left from indefinite hiatuses or full on disbandings? Meet Good June, a musical journey born from the solo musings of Alex Ilyadis, now a collective force with Jina Moran, Walker Bristol, and Aaron Keith. Originally a solo project, Good June has evolved into a band exploring the diverse styles of Emo and its surroundings.

name: aka RAT
description: aka RAT (she/they) is a house DJ based in Somerville, MA. Drawing from her love of dance music, aka RAT blends tracks to get people moving!

name: Ensemble InEdit
description: Music? Dance? You decide!!

name: DJ Phris
description: Phris is a Brazilian-American DJ who holds a deep passion for Brazilian music. He aims bring the beauty of Brazilian funk and electronic music to an American audience. As a Harvard student, he’s played at many events for college students in the northeast, Brazilian and non-Brazilian. Performing at Somerville Porchfest would mark a significant milestone in Phris's DJ career, offering him a platform to share Brazilian music with a wider audience. You can find him on Instagram and Soundcloud as @1phris.

name: Your Friends in Hell
description: Your Friends in Hell are a 3 piece of creeps and weirdos out of Somerville, Massachusetts. Their music can be described as spooky acoustic, but they’re known to take wild swings into sea shanties, doo-wop, punk rock, and anything that sounds good with an accordion. They can often be found collaborating with drag and burlesque artists for their yearly Halfoween event at The Rockwell, and looking up new words to rhyme with “ghosts”. They can be found on instagram at @Yourfriendsinhell and on Spotify and bandcamp.

name: Condition Baker
description: 90s and 00’s inspired pop punk and grunge band from Somerville

name: Crossing the Line
description: Your favorite Camberville funk/pop band! Our group formed for Porchfest in 2024 and since then we've preformed around Cambridge/Somerville at The Cantab Lounge & The Jungle. We're bringing it back to the OG venue on Line Street with covers of old favorites and some new hits. Follow us on insta: @crossingthe_ ; and Venmo tips to "@freaney" with caption "CTL Porchfest" ; Members: Gabby-vocals, Sophia-saxophone, Chris-guitar, Max-bass, Dan-drums, and Jeff-keys/guitar

name: Off Amory Featuring MC and Cloud
description: We are a mix of Berkely and New Hampshire musicians playing anywhere we can! We try and play for everyone hitting everything from James Brown and the Beatles to Alicia Keys and Bruno Mars. You may not know what we will play, but you can know that it will be fun and make you ready to dance

name: Join the IRS!
description: This is the band of the Intergalactic Rainbow Soup cooperative. We are not a cult, but we do have a cult following. We will be playing a mix of irish and bluegrass stringband tunes, and folk tunes with some sing-alongs!

name: Cosmografia
description: Analog synths and techno beats. 7+ years of amazing porchfest shows using homemade modular synths and other noisemaking devices. If you're a fan of LCD Soundsystem, Hot Chip, and electro-sleaze stop by for a high-energy set featuring special guest Fog Labs

name: The Rockery
description: Your favorite cover band, probably.

name: The Goonie Birds
description: The Goonie Birds are a group of music teacher friends who play family-friendly folk music. Bring the whole family and be ready to sing and dance along!

name: Olioid & Viper's Jive
description: Olioid is a two-piece that somehow sounds like a full band. They mix electronic textures, funky grooves, and harmonies, building everything live with a looper, layer by layer, in real time. Their sets feel loose and alive, more like a jam than a scripted performance. Songs shift, grow, and can get weird while aiming to be fun and danceable. Viper's Jive will finish the two hour slot with their dancy, fun music for their 4th appearance on the Bow St stage! 4:15p: Olioid 5:00p: Viper's Jive Free refreshments and snacks!

name: Bird Friend
description: Rooted in folk and DIY, Bird Friend’s sound also blends elements of punk, early psych and garage rock, slowcore and alt-country. Noted for its literate lyricism and unique guitar work, Bird Friend has been on the DIY scene for over ten years, performing in basements, bars, and clubs all over the United States. Restless and experimental by nature, the band has collaborated with artists, musicians, and poets to create an identity that sounds like nothing else, yet is unmistakably theirs.

name: No Stalgia
description: Come for the nostalgia, stay for the party. From neon-soaked 80s anthems, to millennial bangers, to today's chart toppers, No-Stalgia delivers the soundtrack to your best memories - and the ones you haven't made yet.

name: KNTRL
description: Traveling space to bring you gems of House, techno, and UK bass from the final frontier. Costumes encouraged, dancing shoes recommended. See ya there, space cowboy!

name: Locust
description: Winthrop based band active for 2+ years. This will be our second time at Porchfest in Somerville and we are very excited to be a part of it! Band members include: Mckayla Norris (Vocals), Jackson Tolliver (Vocals and Bass), Steven Holgersen (Lead Guitar), David Fisher (Rhythm Guitar), and Kevin Barrera (Drums). To see more of us, we are @Locust_Music on instagram!

name: Handle Slide and friends
description: Join Handle Slide and friends for a merry afternoon of folk and jazz.

name: our neighbours will be THRILLED
description: Hitting you harder than a $17 sandwich in Davis Square, ONWBT bring peak middle-aged mom-and-dad jam band energy to Porchfest. Unleashing anthem after epic anthem: heavy on face-melting guitar solos, cameo instruments, and ubiquitous cowbell, we serve up 90s pop classics with a splash of ill-advised country and the occasional recent chart-topper. We’ll shred until the cows come home and/or it’s time to pick up groceries at H-Mart.

name: Kamikaze Bingo
description: Kamikaze Bingo are an indie-folk duo based in Somerville, MA comprised of Singer-Songwriter Sean Lemkey and Guitarist/ Vocalist Steve Panacek. Sean and Steve met playing in bands together down in New Orleans in the mid-2010s and reconnected in the Boston metro area in 2025. Kamikaze Bingo plays an eclectic mix of original compositions, reimagining songs from previous projects and writing novel material. Their influences range from legends such as Pink Floyd, Fleetwood Mac, and Paul Simon to more contemporary artists such as Fleet Foxes, Mt. Joy, and Radiohead.

name: Civic Duty: The International School of Boston's High School Rock Band
description: Civic Duty is the dynamic High School Rock Band from the International School of Boston (ISB). This energetic collective is composed of talented students ranging from 9th to 12th grade, guided by their music teacher. The band's mission throughout the school year is to hone their performance skills by covering and arranging their favorite rock songs for their concerts. Civic Duty is excited to make their highly anticipated debut at Somerville Porchfest! Students will be accompanied by their parents, music teacher, and school staff and administrators.

name: LBK
description: alternative hits from the 70's and 80's

name: Lobster Ilegal
description: We are 'Lobster Ilegal', five Latin Americans who've planted roots in Boston. We play rock in Spanish, loaded with latin rhythms like cumbia and salsa. We have built a solid reputation in the Boston Latin community, playing in big latin festivals in Boston like Viva Colombia, Viva México and the Peruvian Juerga!. Expect a bilingual show with danceable rock that represents Latin America.

name: Trivia Dogs
description: Acoustic pop covers for you, your uncle, and your grandma.

name: Mixtape Misfits
description: Mixtape Misfits is Greater Boston’s premier 1990s and 2000s rock tribute band. We play the best of alt-rock, grunge, pop-punk, emo, and more. From early 90s classics by Nirvana and Pearl Jam, to turn of the century hits by blink-182 and The Killers, to more recent rock anthems by Fall Out Boy and My Chemical Romance. Mixtape Misfits is : Josh Davis – Lead Vocals Chris Pitre – Guitar Dave Rothfarb – Drums Mike Tedescucci – Bass and Vocals John Zablocki – Guitar and Keyboard

name: Circle the Block
description: We’re an aspiring local band that plays a mix of genres including Pop, Punk, Rock, Funk, R&B, and Soul. Come stop by, chill for a bit, and enjoy some tunes

name: PK and the Mighty Seven
description: PK and the Mighty Seven is a 9-piece Somerville-based band with female and male lead vocals, a dynamic 4-piece rhythm section, and a vibrant 3-piece horn section. We began 11 years ago as a Jamiroquai cover band with a residency at the Middle East club in Cambridge, and our repertoire has since expanded to cover a wide range of musical genres, including soul, funk, pop, R&B, jazz, and beyond). We typically play at weddings and other events, but Somerville Porchfest is always our favorite performance of the year.

name: Hummingbyrd
description: An indie-rock band which plays your favorite hits and originals. We put on a loud, fun show that is welcome to all! Featuring vocals, guitars, piano, synth, bass, horns, and, drums we'll have you bopping to the rhythm and swaying to the beat.

name: Scam Likely
description: Scam Likely is a classic and alternative rock cover band that has been playing everywhere from the Bebop to the Midway to the Green Dragon downtown. We love to play music we love and we love seeing people have a great time! Be sure to stop by our set!

name: Old Tom & the Lookouts
description: Led by Alex Calabrese, Boston-based indie-folk band Old Tom & The Lookouts blend the introspective grit of Americana with the emotional rawness of indie rock. Known for their brooding lyrics and powerful storytelling, the band explores themes of mental health, love, and resilience. Drawing influences from artists like Tom Waits, Frightened Rabbit, and Phoebe Bridgers, Calabrese’s evocative vocals and poignant songwriting strike a chord with listeners searching for authenticity and emotional depth. Old Tom & the Lookouts just recently sold out Club Passim on March 19th, 2026!

name: Acid Basket
description: Join Acid Basket for an eclectic mix of dance, funk, and experimental beats. Acid Basket is a collective of DJs and live Acid House producers.

name: The Hungry Caterpillar
description: Call Me Auntie Time: 2-2:50 Coffee Bong Time: 2:50-4 Description: Coffee Bong is like mixing uppers with downers: you know you want to feel something, but you have no idea what.

name: Ambitchous
description: Ambitchous is a group of five friends in a pop cover band. We are excited to be performing at Porchfest for the sixth year in a row! Good vibes only; every song is a sing-along song. This year's theme is EMO NIGHT.

name: Jake & The Jiggles
description: Bluegrass duet playing folk and traditional music. Come listen!

name: Sam Bergquist
description: Blending Americana, folk, and roots influences, Sam Bergquist creates songs that balance grit and whimsy, tradition and originality. His latest release, Devils & Doves, expands that palette with textured arrangements and sharply observed songwriting. “It comes out like something you’ve never heard before.” — John Aspice, Americana Highways

name: Boston Community Chamber Music
description: We are bringing our community of musicians together to share live classical chamber music in a relaxed neighborhood setting.

name: Patrick McGavick / Johnny Monday / Kenyons
description: We are four musicians and we like to play acoustic covers of songs

name: East Hill
description: Get your kicks at PorchFest '26. Come shine or rain, the East Hill band is hitting 35 Burnside with a 2-hour cacophony of upbeat Folk-Rock, Jamband Americana, Psychadelic Blues, and that lullaby you hazily recollect from the pre-formative era of your brain's sentience. Stop by and say hi!

name: FEEP and Today Junior
description: FEEP is named for an alien and sounds like a haunted house. Today Junior has the most rehearsal space Christmas lights of any band in Boston.

name: Circuit Jumper
description: Circuit Jumper is a Prog/Fusion Groove band drawing influences from a wide variety of sounds across jazz, rock, metal, and electronic mediums. Consisting primarily of drums and fretless bass, they are driven by the interplay of those two instruments and augmented by synthesizers to create groove laden atmospheres worthy of movement.

name: Right on Red
description: Right On Red; 3 dudes that love getting funky and having fun.

name: The Magnus Quintet
description: The Magnus Quintet is a Somerville-based jazz sextet who have been performing together since 2017

name: Midnight Motion
description: Midnight Motion is a funk, soul, and R&B based in the Boston area. We play music in the Stevie Wonder and Bruno Mars style. We have played Somerville Porchfest for many years, and we are super excited to be play again.

name: MATT MARAUDER
description: Matt Marauder is a sonic architect of the Boston rave scene. Inspired by the cinematic worlds of Blade, The Matrix, and Mortal Kombat, his music is a relentless fusion of industrial techno, hard house, and raw, futuristic energy—designed to transport you into a high-voltage, digital battlefield…or a dancefloor. With tribal drums, hypnotic synths, and relentless attitude, Matt Marauder curates immersive, high-intensity soundscapes that pulse like the heartbeat of a machine uprising. His sets are not just music.. They’re anthems for the rebels of the night, a call to arms for those who dance on the edge of reality. Step into his world, where rave is revolution, and the future is now.

name: Wicked Fluffy
description: Boston based Wicked Fluffy is an instrumental group the melds together elements of rock, funk, and jazz with an emphasis on groove and aim to get the audience moving

name: Hot Potato
description: We’re a group of parents who love bringing families together through music—singing kid-friendly songs to create a fun, welcoming PorchFest experience for little ones and their grown-ups. Expect familiar tunes, big smiles, and plenty of chances to jump in, sing along, and be part of the fun.

name: Talking Deads
description: (We did accrue a large crowd on whitman street last year)

name: TIFFY
description: fuzz-tinged dream rock

name: SCROD
description: Brutal bass riffs reek of rotten refuse. Demolished drums soak in stinking sweat. Lean over the bait barrel and inhale the fetid stench of Somerville bass-and-drums duo SCROD as they slather Somerville in sludge at their third Porchfest performance. Prepare by listening to their debut release, "Bait Barrel EP", available on bandcamp. xoxo scrod loves u

name: Harbor Unknown
description: Happy to be back after having our band debut at 2025's Porchfest under our original name, CLOVIS. Harbor Unknown is a mix of dark rock, punk, and shoegaze who takes inspiration from groups like Royal Blood, Badflower, and Boston Manor.

name: Bealtaine
description: Irish and Scottish, mostly pure-drop trad. Jigs and reels with a few songs. Come for the craic!

name: Blueberry Jam
description: Traditional fiddle tunes.

name: Squirrel Therapy
description: Dusty, crooked, sweet, and occasionally feral, Squirrel Therapy is an acoustic trio of singing multi-instrumentalists whose creations are equal parts back-alley croon, porch-swing banjo, and late-night speakeasy haze. Expect originals that cast spells, harmonies that ignite the air, and rhythms that cluck and scurry.

name: Dirty Water Brass Band
description: Dirty Water Brass Band, a staunch contributor to the many grooves that make the Boston-area tick. Dirty Water brings their movable block party to you, doesn’t matter where. Unplugged and mobile, they definitely do NOT "have to be in by 12 o'clock". [Dirty Water will be raising awareness and passing the hat for the non-profit MA TPS Committee (https://www.masstps.org/donate). No tax-deductible donation will be too small — or too large.]

name: Family MTG
description: Family Meeting is a family of 7 (unfortunately not actually related) with keys, bass, guitar, violin, sax, drums, and vocals. We play mostly covers ranging from jazz, indie, pop, and funk with some oldies thrown in for fun. *last year we played under the name identity crisis but since having some members change decided to change the name as well*

name: Why Try?
description: Why Try? is a Boston-based alt-rock band with a 90's inspired sound. Their lyrics delve into themes of mental health awareness, social issues, love, connection, and personal growth. From frenetic and satirical to melancholy and melodic, Why Try's discography demonstrates a sonic variety that will appeal to almost anyone who loves to rock

name: The Velvet Dirtmunchers
description: The Velvet Dirtmunchers are a genre-bending sextet from Medford, MA featuring sultry vocals, squeezebox, and impudent (mouthy! hellacious!) horns.

name: the black souls
description: Cool garage rock feat longtime Boston frontman Cam Ackland on vocs and harmonica with a great backing band. Fun 60's r&b songs, great for all ages!

name: Interzone
description: We are an indie rock band that plays everything from originals to covers of bands like The Strokes, Surf Curse, and Two Door Cinema Club! A lot of our originals are inspired by bands such as these, but we really like to play anything, from punk all the way to 80s soft rock. (What will we play at PorchFest? Find out when you come see us!) We are a band based out of Boston and are four guys who play music simply because we love to do it. We have two guitarists, a bassist, and a drummer. We hope you are as excited to see us as we are to see you. Insta: interzone.ma

name: jill mccracken
description: jill mccracken (they/them) is a queer singer/songwriter making emotionally raw retro soul music. heartfelt passion and vocal power remain front and center whether it’s a boisterous full band performance or an intimate solo set. mccracken’s influence has resonated with their home city of boston, earning consistent boston music award nominations over the past six years (singer/songwriter, vocalist of the year), clinching a new england music award (soul/r&b act of the year), and being regarded as “a force to reckon with in the boston music community” (allston pudding).

name: Morningside Music Jazz Ensembles
description: A group of passionate adult musicians who get together regularly to play the music they love — jazz standards, bop, jazz-rock, bossa nova, and beyond. Celebrating their 10th year performing at Porchfest on Newbury Street.

name: These Stains Are Who I Am
description: Two friends writing songs about love, folly, and raccoons. We play fun, original, upbeat rock music, from one-off singles to entire concept albums. In the last few years we made an interactive choose-your-own-adventure album, "The Concert," and released a hard-rock EP and music video called "GIANT SNAKE."

name: Matt Carbonello & The Red Carpet Band
description: Hosted by: Life Alive Organic Café A homage and revue of 60s/70s rock through a blend of blues, folk psychedelia, & roots rock through original and cover songs

name: Magnificent Danger
description: Magnificent Danger is an energetic collective of brass and percussion dishing out funky mashups of iconic tunes from your favorite video games and anime. Their mixture of big band, New Orleans second line, riot jazz, funk, and hip-hop creates a bizarre but danceable party appreciated by musicians and nerds alike.

name: Scrivener
description: Songs that make you feel good about feeling bad. Scrivener draws on folk, chamber pop, and Americana to craft their sound, which is at once intimate and grandiose–the songs range from fingerstyle acoustic confessions to orchestral theatrics. The band released their latest album, a full-length titled "Nuclear Winter in Our Hometowns," in December of 2025.

name: BAABES
description: Boston Punk Rock!

name: On Regret
description: “Your hands pass through mine…” The saddest sound in Boston is the alt-emo juggernaut composed of Tim Maloney (guitar, vocals), Zach Downs (Guitar, vocals), Dan Feller (drums), Jonah Philbert (bass), and Priya Sapra (guitar). Since 2019, On Regret’s heart wrenching lyrics, interwoven soundscapes, and dirty power chords have carried audiences on haunting, breakneck journeys through tragedy, aging, frustration, and loss. After 5 years, the band’s sophmore album released May of 2024. ‘Burning Old Photos’ is a mixture of stand-alone pop punk singles, screaming hardcore laments, and intimate chainsaw-laden jams.

name: SHY HUSKY
description: Founded in the back woods of Vermont and now finding a home in Boston, Shy Husky blends the energy of early 2000's emo and punk with the mainstream appeal and accessibility of modern pop. Optimistic lyrics and earworm hooks contrast with fiery guitar riffs and pounding drums to bring something for everyone in their unique brand of power pop. For fans of Jimmy Eat World, Third Eye Blind, The Weakerthans, Motion City Soundtrack, The Wombats “A distillation of decades’ worth of rock” (Chris Farnsworth, Seven Days).

name: Bass Oasis
description: We are a group of local DJs who play a wide variety of music! For Porchfest, we will be playing House, Top 40, Latin House, and more to appeal to the masses.

name: Stella Starfox
description: Stella Starfox is a Boston-based psychedelic pop band, blending elements from rock, psychedelia, hip-hop and electronica. With songs offering dance-inducing rhythms, thought-provoking themes and hilarious one-liners, there is sure to be something for everyone at a Stella show.

name: Indigo
description: We're a pop cover band founded by Harvard College students in 2022. This will be our second time having the honor to perform at Somerville Porchfest!

name: The Massive Letdowns
description: Come get your rock band + saxophone fix! A few covers, some new originals, and a lot of personality. In other words – a guaranteed good time!

name: Honana
description: Old friends playing original indie music.

name: Antarctica
description: Antarctica is a duo performing the best 60s and 70s Pop Classics, the songs everyone remembers and loves, at Fairs, Farmers Markets, festivals, and (of course) Porchfests. You can see our videos, songlist, etc, at http://antarcticaband.com

name: Vibe Box
description: Vibe Box is an improvisatory adventure. With keyboard, mic, and loop station, we spontaneously create music; sort of how mold spores are carried in the wind and cultivate unique cheeses. Vibe Box is headed by Zack Berger and features a rotating cast of improvisers and musicians from the Somerville area.

name: Joanne the Band
description: Boston based indie-folk duo, Joanne the Band is comprised of Anna VanValkenburgh and Jocelyn Bailey. The pair started off as coworkers and never truly left that title. They spent 2 years writing with each other leading to their debut project, Neither All or In Between. The EP deals with themes of rejection, grief, and the acceptance of inevitable change while serving as an introduction to the band's sound. Joanne's hope is to serve as a new england artist collective; acting as a landing pad for their community's creative humans, always expanding and evolving.

name: Jake K. & The Royal Mess
description: Jake K. & The Royal Mess is an indie rock band built on honest songs, melodic hooks, and the moments in life that are hard to put into words. Led by singer-songwriter Jake K., the project blends indie pop, alt folk, and bits and pieces from every genre that’s shaped them along the way. For Jake, songwriting has always been the place to figure things out — to say the things that don’t always come out right in everyday life. The band’s sound is playful, emotional, sometimes messy — but always real. At the end of the day, it isn’t about being polished or perfect. It’s about finding meaning in the chaos and making music that feels honest, in whatever form that takes.

name: Buck Lonesome & The Table for One
description: Buck Lonesome is proud to play country & western music that draws from the genre's golden age up to the 1990s. Our originals are composed in a broad range of styles, including classic/traditional, outlaw, Bakersfiled, countrypolitan, western swing, alternative country/cowpunk, and 90s neo-traditional. We round out our sets with classic covers from favorites including Dwight Yoakam, Merle Haggard, Radney Foster, and other giants. In 2023, we released our EP, Rambler in a Strange Land, which can be found on Spotify, Apple Music, and other platforms. Follow us on Instagram @Buck_Lonesome

name: Hope Symphony
description: Hope Symphony is the creator of Music Anarchy, which combats the paradigm that music is only music if it follows rules. Hope Symphony expresses her inner music through the body, via electric guitar and piano/organ improvisations.

name: WonderBox
description: Great classic rock from a talented and versatile 6-member band featuring two Berklee grads. Don't just sing along, pick up a tambourine, maracas, a wood block, and yes cow bells and help the band play well-known songs from Billy Idol, Led Zeppelin, Pink Floyd, The Beatles, David Bowie, and Stone Temple Pilots. This will be our 6th year at PorchFest and it's such a blast playing for all of you!!

name: Orbiter
description: Orbiter is a four piece rock band that plays music to get the people going! Lovers of 90s music will appreciate their overdriven, rhythmic, and yet sweet and melodic sound. Orbiter put out their debut album Tough To Say in November with a sold out release show at local BBQ joint Redbones, and by the time you're reading this their new single "Is It Home" will be out everywhere.

name: fudoublehockeysticks
description: We are a indie/rock/jazz band who love exploring genres and playing bops. We formed after one evening of frisbee and the name fudoublehockeysticks was born out of a random postgame bit. We have not looked back since, collaborating with friends <3 and producing music we find fun and interesting.

name: xtrevort
description: Jersey-born and Boston-bred. xtrevort is a rapper, producer, and one-man operation making jazz-rap that meets you where you are. In the vein of Mac Miller, Tyler the Creator, and Saba, his sound is groovy, lyrical, and alive in a way that's hard to shake. He writes, produces, and performs everything himself. On stage, it shows. High energy, high movement, and the kind of set that makes you wonder how you hadn't heard of him yet and why it took you this long to find him. Catch up with his first EP xtrevort'd and stay tuned for what's coming. His debut album is dropping this summer 2026. Step into the kitchen before there's nothing left.

name: The Koiis & Island of Alaska
description: 2:00 - 3:00: The Koiis 3:00 - 4:00: Island of Alaska The Koiis are a Somerville based rock band with funky covers and rockin originals, crowd participation encouraged. Island of Alaska is a Somerville based pop-punk band who've been making the rounds in the scene for years and have amassed a wild set of covers and originals any emo kid would proudly mosh to.

name: studio Z band
description: A group of longtime friends and seasoned musicians, who have been playing classic rock music of the 60's, 70's and 80's for almost 40 years. Our emphasis is on compelling vocals and tight performances of iconic songs from that era. Our selections include both hits and deeper cuts of our favorite artists, including the Rolling Stones, Grateful Dead, Neil Young, Tom Petty and many others. This is music we have great fondness for and find many others enjoy as well. We are committed to keeping this great music alive.

name: Max & Happy
description: Acoustic singer/songwriter

name: Chef Dumbbirch
description: Alt rock and blues rock quartet

name: Real Fake Doors
description: Brother duo performing electric and acoustic versions of popular rock and punk songs.

name: Poker Knight
description: We are a 2000s punk rock cover band playing all bangers, all the time. See you there!

name: The Book Club
description: The Book Club is a Boston-based cover band founded by alumni of BC bOp!, the premier jazz ensemble of Boston College. The Book Club's sets provide audiences with a wide variety of classic and contemporary tunes, tailored to the talents of the band. And yes, we might play Free Bird.

name: The Murpheyz
description: Classic rock covers from the 60's and 70's

name: gary.
description: gary.

name: Chasing Hues
description: Ando 4:00-4:30 Sora 4:30-5:00 Sorry, Ma 5:00-5:30 Everfiner 5:30-6:00 A modern, acoustic singer-songwriter husband/wife duo from St. John, USVI playing a mix of originals and covers. Chill vibes, incredible vocals and rocking acoustic guitar!

name: Fly By Brass Band
description: We are a 15 piece brass band out of the greater Somerville area who enjoys playing interesting and approachable music. Born of the local HONK scene we focus on bringing live horn harmonies to the people. Our tastes are eclectic, performing everything from second-line inspired jazz to upbeat rock. The main theme is: "does this make us feel good and would it delight others?"

name: foamflower
description: We sing, we rock, and oh do we bloom.

name: MARS
description: Since 2007, Mars has been rocking audiences with catchy tunes and compelling performances, establishing themselves as a favorite among local music lovers in Boston. Mars Rock Band blends authentic musicianship with diverse styles, creating memorable psychedelic-tinged power-pop songs rooted in classic rock that resonate with fans. The dual talents of songwriters Chris Gorham and Michael “Ammo” Amundson drive the band’s unique sound.

name: Lily Mae Harrington
description: Lily Mae Harrington was born and raised on Cape Cod. Her music has been featured on SiriusXM and spotifys “fresh finds”. She played fan favorite “Felicia” on Hulu’s “single drunk female”. Her music gives new age quirky Sheryl Crow vibes perfect for Porch fest.

name: Trash Mangos
description: A few friends who like to jam - we play a mix of covers and originals! We have five members - Katie Vinter on vocals and rhythm guitar, Joey Roberts on lead guitar, Joe Ledger on bass, Rachel Morrison on drums and backup vocals, and Kate Dagnall on piano. What we lack in skill, we make up for in enthusiasm - we hope to see you at the performance!

name: Steep
description: Steep is an inclusive, underground party series focused on creating immersive listening experiences on vinyl. Founded by Sam Belt (current resident of Somerville @ 12 Skehan St) and Charles Manzella (lives just over the border in inman square), we both have been coming to porchfest for over a decade. Steep has been running for 2 years and have welcomed over 20 artists from 9 different countries alongside some of the US's own best talent from NYC, Detroit, LA, and Salt Lake City. We curate events and build line ups that include combine these touring artists with homegrown talent, our goal is always to prioritize highlighting under appreciated talent, not social media followers or clout.

name: 88mph
description: Indie rock 5 piece

name: Julien Orlando
description: Julien Orlando is a indie singer-songwriter and multi instrumentalist. He records songs in his bedroom to make you cry Julien's first album, "The Waiting Room" is available on all streaming platforms. For PorchFest this year, Julien will be playing alongside friends and collaborators Autumn McHugh (vocals, guitar) and Maddie Speagle (vocals, banjo, violin). They will be playing some new material from Julien's upcoming indie-folk EP, "The Salton Sea" as well as some classic folk covers.

name: Keyon & The Associates
description: Rolling Stones. Noah Kahan. Sam Fender. Maroon V. Keyon & The Associates.

name: Johnson Reed & Then Some
description: 3 piece band with killer vocals and guest players/singers. Old and new rock and blues.

name: Kerosene
description: Indie/alt rock 3-piece band playing originals and covers with a 90s influence

name: The Recliners
description: The Recliners are a four-piece acoustic band featuring fiddle, mandolin, guitar and standup bass. We perform songs from the best of folk, country, bluegrass, gospel and originals in three and four-part harmony. We enjoy playing at Porchfests and other outdoor and indoor events as well as private parties.

name: Can O Worms
description: Since 2023, Can O Worms has been wriggling its way into the ears of the Massachusetts music scene! Based in Waltham, MA, the cover band plays a bold mix of genres – anything from classic rock, to pop hits, funky indie grooves, and everything in between! Variety is the spice of life and the Worms serve up a little bit of everything – with a tangy mix of fan-favorites and unexpected earworms. Our audacious musicians bring a cool energy and positive vibe to every show. Each setlist is crafted to create fun performances that keep the audience on their feet and singing long after the show is over. Can O Worms rocked all of Somerville last year, now witness them return with an electric force!

name: Phoenix & Raine
description: Phoenix & Raine are an Americana folk duo with roots in Appalachia and New England folk scenes. Their sound is reminiscent of time lost in the deep forest communing with moss.

name: Leonard da Vincis
description: The Leonard da Vincis bring a mix of rock, indie, and soulful tunes.

name: Jackson G. (DJ Set)
description: Jackson G. is a beginner DJ playing a mix of genres, including (Hard) Techno, UKG, and Trance.

name: Poster Colors
description: Folk, rock, folk-rock, made by Jonah, Dan, Tommy, and Jacob.

name: Jack Sloan
description: Jack Sloan is an indie rock artist based in Cambridge.

name: Ajda the Turkish Queen
description: Ajda the Turkish Queen is a singer-songwriter who's been on the Boston music scene for many moons. She performs her original songs on mandolin and guitar. Hailing from Texas, but borne of a Turkish mother, her sound has been described as rootsy yet ethereal. Influences include PJ Harvey, Nick Cave, and Nico (and too many others to count), and she has been compared to Aimee Mann and Thalia Zedek.

name: Lemon Queens
description: We’re two ladies harmonizing with a ukulele, joined by some talented, musical friends. Expect an eclectic mix of good vibes: from oldies to fresh hits, girl anthems to boy ballads, some get-up-and-dance tunes, and a few sway-and-hug-your-neighbor moments. Come hang out and chill with us!

name: Nick and the Dads
description: We are Nick and the Dads, a Cambridge-based dad rock band. We play 90s/2000s rock covers. We play all the hits from the bands you love: Green Day, Foo Fighters, RHCP, Weezer, Killers, Blink-182 plus some deeper cuts that will take you back to the greatest era of music

name: Gallos Locos
description: Latin Rock

name: Good Trouble Brass Band
description: https://www.somervillemusicspaces.com/ Meet at CALA covered plaza The Good Trouble Brass Band is a large, not-for-profit, “raucous, stomp-your-foot-and-belt-out-the-choruses” activist New Orleans-style street band based in Somerville and Cambridge, Massachusetts. Our mission is to fight for social justice causes and support community events while having fun and spreading joy through our music. We are also a part of the organizing force behind the HONK!Festival of activist street bands that takes place every October in Somerville’s Davis Square.

name: money$tella
description: Hosted by www.somervillemuseum.org Indie-dance rock played by very ordinary looking people. Arguably the fifth or sixth best LCD Soundystem tribute band north of the Charles River.

name: Jackaroo and Company
description: A family string band (guitar and bass), Jackaroo and Company play music for children of all ages, including folk, country and western, and novelty songs. Participants are invited to join in (bring an instrument to play, sing, dance, skip, clap) for any or all songs!

name: Snail Teeth
description: Snail Teeth is a Boston-formed band with roots in New Hampshire, Boston, and Ireland. Known for their raw, honest approach to songwriting and performance, the band delivers something for everyone and an experience you won’t forget.

name: PHUC
description: PHUC (Pronounced ph - oo - k) is a contemporary music trio that defies genre boundaries with their innovative and dynamic sound. Composed of Jake D'Ambra on tenor saxophone, J.P. Heston on upright bass, and Caleb Cronan on drums, the group has established a unique voice through their contrapuntal approach, weaving together elements of various musical styles. Based in the Northeast, the trio has honed their craft through performance and collaboration, cultivating a style that is both concise and imaginative. The trio's music is propelled by their commitment to original composition and arranging, and their shared interest in exploration.

name: Double Star
description: Boston-based Double Star mixes punk riffs, high-energy horns, and lush harmonies to create pop-rock tunes that defy easy categorization. A series of serendipitous Craigslist meetings brought them together, but a devotion to making music that’s both wacky and sophisticated, and above all catchy as hell, has kept them together since 2017.

name: À La Carte
description: Jazz kids who love all genres with a good groove, be it a song by D’Angelo, Nancy Sinatra, The Meters, or The Turtles, were sure to get your feet dancing and will have you for an a la carte musical experience.

name: Lady in the Radiator
description: Horrorpunk Cover Band

name: naDJa B2B what the bec
description: naDJa B2B what the bec. melodic house, tech house, everything in between. bringing festival vibes to the porch, come dance.

name: Wario Speedwagon
description: Wario Speedwagon is a cover band that plays rock & pop from the 70s-00s. We don't just play the songs you know, we play the ones you forgot you loved. REO? Never heard of 'em.

name: PlantHouse
description: PlantHouse plays an eclectic mix of pop, indie, and alternative R&B covers and originals.

name: Hush Honey
description: We are a Boston-based blues and soul band. Music includes Albert King, Ruth Brown, Little Walter, Aretha Franklin, Howling Wolf, and Magic Sam. We bring an up-tempo vibe and can keep the dance floor packed. We've played many porchfests, including Somerville last year.

name: Crumpled List
description: We are a group of local Somerville/Boston musicians playing our second Porchfest with a mix of rock, alternative, indie, and some surprises! Most of us have been playing music together for over a decade. Last years turnout was fantastic and we are looking forward to this years show! You can expect to sing along and jam out with rock songs from the 50s to now. See you there!

name: The Maniac Loves You
description: Hosted by: https://republicbos.com/ -- walk towards the back of the property. 90s/00s Rock and Pop

name: Puke Pisstols
description: Garage Rock N Roll from Boston featuring members of Andy California, The Monsieurs, and Pledge Pins. For the 8th year running, join us at "The Beacon" -- the gravel parking lot at 18 Waldo Ave in Somerville -- for the best day of the year! Food, great riffs, all for a good cause. We proudly raise voluntary donations for The Somerville Homeless Coalition each year and are excited to do it again this year.

name: Whyte Lipstick
description: Whyte Lipstick is a Boston-based garage punk trio featuring Coco (from Electric Street Queens) on bass/vocals, alongside Francesca and Mary. Known for raw, snotty, and energetic punk rock, the band released their debut album Deadbeat and the TRASH demo in 2025–2026. —- Message from the PorchFest Host — Please join us at "The Beacon" — the gravel parking lot at 18 Waldo Ave — for the best day of the year! For the 8th year running, we will have food, great rock riffs, all for a good cause. We proudly raise voluntary donations for The Somerville Homeless Coalition, a group we're excited to support again this year. See you at the 'fest! \m/

name: Lithophones
description: Boston based garage punk featuring ex members of the Tampoffs, Tokyo Electron and the Wongs. --- Message from the PorchFest host --- For the 8th year running, please join us at "The Beacon" -- the gravel parking lot at 18 Waldo Ave -- for the best day of the year! We'll have food, great rock riffs, all for a good cause! We are proud to take voluntary donations in support of The Somerville Homeless Coalition. See you at the 'fest!

name: Summer Fling
description: Summer Fling is a high-energy pop/rock/funk band featuring a dynamic three-piece horn section, known for creating immersive, feel-good live shows that bring people together. Rooted in joy, spontaneity, and connection, the band blends tight musicianship with a party-forward energy that keeps audiences dancing and fully in the moment. They’ve performed at notable stages including Elements Music Festival, Mr. Purple, and Stephen Talkhouse.

name: sunnydaze & Mega Fauna
description: 2-3pm Mega Fauna 3-4pm Sunnydaze, founded at Tufts in 2022, is a funk-pop collective based right here in Somerville. With influences ranging from Stevie Wonder to Lake Street Dive and Olivia Dean, sunnydaze has the funk to keep you going, but the versatility to always keep you on your toes. Prepare to internalize the funkiness of our smooth vocals and groovy basslines, followed by epic guitar solos and plenty of familiar tunes. Meet the band below: Clara Scheutz - lead vocals Justin Kamal - vocals and sax Matt Gomez - bass Daniella Rothstein - drums Josh Blum - guitar Adam Bernstein - keys and vocals

name: Alligator Noise
description: A conglomeration of sonic experiences distilled, then distorted via the interpretations of 6 individuals in what can only be described as human performance, despite the reptilian implications of the group's name.

name: Rain House
description: Rain House is an indie/post-punk/folk rock band from Boston.

name: The Heart of Gold Band
description: Playing the music of the Grateful Dead, with a few rock classics in the mix.

name: The Ways and Means Committee
description: The Ways and Means Committee (WAMC) is a roots-rock/Americana Soul combo drawing on the record collections of our hippy antecedents & spirit of the Indy revolution. Playing both original tunes and creative covers, the band features soulful vocals, sweet harmonies, electric mandolin, pedal steel, acoustic guitar, electric bass, blues harp, drums and percussion.

name: Dylan and the Rat Boys
description: Pop and jam music

name: The Ruckus
description: Rock and Roll covers spanning the 80s, 90s and 2000s

name: The Incorrigible String Band
description: Americana and Bluegrass, including some original songs by Somerville's John O'Brien

name: Soulo
description: Soulo is a Boston-based band that describes their style as “jazz hotpot,” drawing inspiration from the Chinese communal dish—layered, adaptive, and built from diverse ingredients. Their music brings together elements of jazz hip-hop, R&B, J-rock, and soul, weaving Chinese and English lyrics in the most exhausted sentimental expression. With an algorithmic mindset, they write music like a math puzzle. Using groove as the kernel, treating other pieces as a Markov process, their music aims to build a rich and structured music experience.

name: Taximi
description: We are a group of musicians brought together through our passion for Greek music. Taximi in Greek means the solo performed at the beginning or at intermediate points of a song. It is a symbol for individual freedom in expression.

name: Midnight Turntable
description: All your favorites from the 60s and 70s

name: Blues Woman
description: Blues Woman plays groovy rock n' roll covers and cheeky original tunes. Swing on by to hear folk music that speaks to the soul and gets your toes tapping ! Song themes include: Travel, the Sea, Healing a Broken Heart, and an Ode to everyone's favorite Somerville pasta shop. For Fans Of: The Beatles, The Grateful Dead, Animal Collective, Courtney Barnett, & Dr. Dog.

name: Ya-G's
description: Behold the Ya-G's, a band birthed during Covid by scruffy neighborhood dads deprived of live music and deciding to make their own. In true rock fashion, they chewed up a succession of drummers before finding their beating heart in the person of one of their very own daughters. They’re multi-instrumentalists, but whatever they play, from accordion to slide guitar, it’s all about the song. Depending on where their fancy leads them, the set list might include Prince, VU, Waterboys, Beatles, XTC, Replacements, Talking Heads, Tarbox Ramblers, Kinks, and some originals too —all with jangly rhythms and hoarse harmonies that’ll make you want to sing and stomp along.

name: Sonicater
description: Francesca Larson, Dan Rossetti, Sarah DuBois-Coyne, Freddy Hamel, Tony Nicolaides

name: Lunch Mother & Otis Grove
description: Hosted by: www.bossorgan.com Lunch Mother: A house band of the Loft, a DIY space in Somerville. The band blends indie rock, folk, and experimental pop, with layered instrumentation, looping textures, and a loose, collaborative energy. Rooted in community, their sound moves between intimate & unpredictable, shaped by live performance. Otis Grove: A funky organ trio delivering a raw, groove-driven blend of rock & roll across the Northeast. Rooted in the classic organ combo tradition, they channel soul, funk, and blues into high-energy live shows. Known for tight interplay and deep grooves, they’ve built a loyal following, with standout performances at venues like Nectar’s in Burlington, VT.

name: Parallel Beats Sound System
description: Parallel Beats Sound System is a live DJ block party playing funk, hip hop, soul, world music, acid jazz, reggae and house music until someone stops us! Expect dancing, tropical drinks and GOOD TIMES! xoxo

name: The Harmonic Modes
description: Cover band from Somerville, MA! Playing the hits from pop, funk, indie, and alternative rock!

name: NOTADOG
description: NOTADOG, is a Somerville-based punk/emo band with a penchant for emotionally earnest lyrics coupled with a fun, down-to-earth play style made to get audiences moving and dancing with the music. This exhilarating 3-piece was created when Fegan, their singer/guitarist, exhausted with 20 years of classical composition, was ready to vent authentically through other means. After meeting Phoenix Campagnuolo (Bass), and Jason Gugick (Drums) at Berklee College of Music, NOTADOG was founded and off to the races with their raucous debut singles, “The Munchies”, “Scared” and “Maybe”.

name: The Honey Badgers
description: Funky improv rock that does what it wants—deep grooves, unexpected left turns, and a total disregard for musical boundaries.

name: The Ben Wetherbee Honky Tonk Band
description: We are a five piece honky tonk band based right here in Somerville! Country grooves soaked in funk, surf, swing, Cajun and Zydeco get our audiences dancing every time as blazing telecaster, pedal steel, and fiddle solos rock the crowd. We play classic country and originals sung by bandleader Ben Wetherbee (fiddle, guitar, and vocals) alongside Alex Formento (pedal steel), Troy Caruana (lead guitar), Joe Everett (bass), and Matt Garvin (drums).

name: The Collect Pond
description: The Collect Pond melds post-punk immediacy, shoegaze, and jangle pop. The Collect Pond is the name under which songwriter Danny Moffat produces his own music. The musicians in The Collect Pond are Moffat: Vocals/Guitar, Chris Anthony: Drums, Rob Carrington: Keys/Bass, and Ben Bonadies: Guitar/Bass. They met through connections as writers with the music blog Allston Pudding. In 2025, they dropped their third album, Absence of Something, on Candlepin Records via tape cassette and digital streaming. Promo shows included an appearance on CBS/WBZ. "They have concocted something of a lo-fi masterpiece with their third album Absence of Something" – Guitar World magazine

name: Plugged In Band Program
description: The Plugged In Band Program has been serving the Metro Boston area for 25 years, providing low or no-cost accessible music education to students of all backgrounds, abilities and educational needs. With a focus on inclusive music curriculum, we serve a wide variety populations and ages, including students on the Autism Spectrum, those living with Down Syndrome or Intellectual Disabilities, and those with limited vision and motor skills. This group is comprised of some of our talented teachers, who will be playing an eclectic set of Rock and Pop classics as we celebrate our 25th birthday, and share our love of music with the Somerville Community.

name: DrawnOnward
description: Drawn Onward is the collectice creative output of Jim Miller and Sam Sencer, local artists, friends and amateur wizards. Simultaneously channeling the past and the future, their music draws the listener onward with them, ever forward. Tastefully influenced by rock, blues, jazz and the natural chaos of the universe. Improvisation and sonic mischief are likely. "We create music that evolves over time - we begin with acoustics and vocals and loop in guitar, bass, and beats."

name: Sweeney & Sweeney
description: Matt & Dan Sweeney are twin brothers who write, produce, mix, and engineer their own projects. Based out of a small suburban town in Massachusetts, they created their debut album, Strangers on the Street, entirely in the bedroom they shared as kids. Their songs cover many different genres, from tender soft rock to disco inspired sounds from the late 70's and even sonic landscapes reminiscent of psychedelic rock. Sweeney & Sweeney will be accompanied by both Shane Lambert on drums and Paul Murray on bass and vocals.

name: Triple Man
description: Nick and Eli playing covers in honor of Triple Man

name: Looncry and TVVision
description: Erik Barth with Looncry are back to Folk-Rock our hearts out! TVVision is here to build stages out of scrap wood and melt some faces! Good times and cajun cooking are a guarantee.

name: Lawn Chair Crisis
description: Six lawn chairs covering your favorite songs

name: Save it For Tonight / Roaches
description: Save it For Tonight is a 4 member Indie Pop Rock band from the Boston area, while Roaches is an organic rock band from Lowell. Two bands, one location!

name: Smith and Company
description: We are a family band returning for our 4th porch fest! We play a mix of classic rock and jam music, covering artists such as the grateful dead, Creedence Clearwater Revival, Almond brothers and more!

name: Grüvmeiners Brass Band
description: A multigenerational, pop-centered, grüv oriented, hip-shakin', booty rattlin', fünky collective of musicians with a mission to light your inner dance diva on fire! We blend lively pop tunes with brash brass sound to get everyone singing and dancing. We started out covering mostly 80's but as we bring in younger players you will find us playing more and more tunes from the 90's to today!

name: FourFourSend
description: 4/4 Send (pronounced “Four Four Send”) is a Boston-based band that currently primarily plays cover songs. Some of these songs are modified versions of the original whereas others try to stick to the source. Our covers are of a mix of pop rock, pop, and folky songs.

name: Goatsbeard
description: Goatsbeard channel Boston rock through the ages from earnest passim folk to the bosstown sound to deadpan proto punk and early indie rock and otts guitar improv to garage revivals. As an indie psych trio the motif is consistent while the players pull each other to their corners and meet in others while the songs aim for different feels. Got to feel lost in one part to be found in another and ride the darkness to find a flip smile on the other side

name: Stick Shift
description: We are a 4-piece band playing rock covers from the '90s and 2000s! Come by to hear familiar favorites from Radiohead, the Cranberries, Boa, Pink Floyd, and more. We love playing together and look forward to rocking out with you all!

name: Elle Carter & Friends
description: Originally hailing from New York City, singer-songwriter Elle Carter currently resides in Boston, MA. Influenced by songwriting luminaries like Jackson Browne, Samuel Beam of Iron & Wine, and Allison Russell, her songs reflect her deep-rooted passion for storytelling and lyricism while also pulling elements from folk, rock, indie, and pop genres to create her unique sound. Elle's latest EP, "The Burden of You," delves into the complexities of love, loss, and self-discovery, offering a genuine and introspective journey through life's ups and downs. "The Burden of You" is now available to stream on ALL streaming platforms!

name: The Merman
description: Hailing from all corners of Boston, Salted Oranges is a collective of explosively-creative musicians united by a shared love of reinvention. We breathe bold new life into the pop classics of decades past—transforming familiar hits into dynamic, groove-driven experiences that feel both nostalgic and entirely new. Drawing from backgrounds in funk, jazz, rock, and pop, our sound is as unpredictable, infectious, and guaranteed to get you moving.

name: Muck Fit
description: The muckiest band in Somerville, MA, and possibly, the world.

name: Analog Crossing
description: Analog Crossing is a four-piece live Video Game Music band based in New York City that reimagines the soundtracks for games you grew up with. They’ve been featured in Time Out, the Rhythm & Pixels Podcast, and Magfest.

name: Alex, Joel, Thomas Trio
description: Jazz Fusion Trio based out of Somerville MA

name: Johnny Fufu Band
description: Come sing a long to some favorites with flare and improvisation, learn some new tunes, dance, make new friends, we look forward to seeing you all again!

name: Luigi's Fishtank
description: Luigi’s Fishtank is an eclectic rock band formed in Somerville amidst the ashes of the former renowned Phoenix-based group, The Fuzz Buckets (2016 - 2024). Building on their extensive busking experience and incorporating novel music influences (including the expertise of a music major), the reincarnated band regularly plays high-energy classic and alternative rock concerts across New England. The band is eager to continue its meteoric rise to fame in the underground music scene.

name: GloveBox
description: A devilishly handsome five-piece rock band that performs all throughout the Greater Boston area! We have multiple current & former residents of Somerville, MA. We've performed at multiple Somerville Porchfests, and always have the best time!

name: Parachute Crisis
description: 4 cats playing some music

name: Tailwind
description: Drawing influence from funk, rock, and soul music, Tailwind's cast of multi-instrumentalists combine soulful vocals with funky rhythms and riffs.

name: Niteshade
description: Formed in 2022, Niteshade is a dynamic collective of Boston-area music teachers and part-time musicians who came together with a shared passion for funk, soul, and jazz fusion. What started as a side project playing porchfests and farmers markets quickly evolved into something bigger, as the band’s infectious energy and tight musicianship propelled them onto some of the most iconic stages in New England. In 2024, Niteshade landed a coveted monthly residency at the legendary Middle East Nightclub in Cambridge, MA, solidifying their place in the region’s vibrant live music scene. Their self-titled debut EP, Niteshade, is available on all streaming services.

name: VibeCHK & Lance Rego
description: VibeCHK is a DJ Trio composed of Local musicians: CoZy (Cory Zografos) Hint of Reason (Henry Hinton) and Kinetic Love (Kenneth Tschan). Diving into the local scene after Porchfest 2022 rapturous return from lockdown - their multi-genre experimentations and theme nights run the gamut of our local scenes, ranging from absolute classics to unhinged imports. Collectively they have their hands in local late night culture throughout Boston, Cambridge, and Somerville - hosting various private local events & local music nights like Patchwork & WTF Fridays at ZuZu.

name: The Anchovies
description: Born in Somerville and now heading into their third Porchfest, The Anchovies are a five-piece rock band known for turning neighborhood porches into full-on street parties. Their sound blends classic rock fire and bluesy jams with psychedelic textures, heavy riffs, and laid-back reggae grooves, moving from singalong favorites to gritty, high-energy rock moments. With a set that spans their own spin on timeless covers and an original song, The Anchovies bring a warm, loud, and joyfully unpredictable energy that feels right at home in the Somerville music scene.

name: The Femmes
description: The Femmes are an all-woman and non-binary wedding band specializing in songs by female and non-binary artists. When you’re at a Femmes show, you’re at a high energy concert experience. Epic sing alongs, expertly crafted harmonies, and musicians who absolutely LOVE to interact with the audience, the Femmes are Boston’s go-to women’s party band! The Femmes have been booked solid since their sold-out debut showcase at Club Cafe in February 2023. Finding quick success in the MA market and all across New England, The Femmes have become one of Boston's top party bands, performing for the Museum of Science, the Human Rights Campaign, the Celtics Pride Night, the Southeast Alaska State Fair, Firs

name: Change Order
description: We're a Boston-based classic rock and 90s cover band who's played at many venues in the Boston area, including The Jungle, Cantab Lounge, the Square Root, House of Blues Foundation Room, Union Tavern, Midway Cafe, local porchfests and corporate events.

name: YAFFA
description: YAFFA is a local folk-soul jam band led by singer-songwriter Jenny Wechter. Moving from shimmering ballads about living waters to brassy rumbles about capitalism and ecstatic anthems of love, her compositions enliven and inspire. YAFFA invites you into a journey of rhythm, reverence, and resonance.

name: 77Suspects
description: Hey! We are the 77Suspects – thanks for checking out out! Five mild mannered professionals by day laying down instrumental grooves by night (or afternoon…in this case). We have been playing together for 20 years (yikes) and are super excited to be joining you all at Porchfest. Join us for a few hours of up beat, instrumental jams which pair nicely with lovely day in the sun. See you there! The 77Suspects

name: Deep Cutz
description: 90’s Rock

name: Crush
description: Crush is a local band of friends from college. They play rock blues and indie, with some originals mixed in. Their diverse sound can be attributed to the variety of instruments played by their talented musicians. Crush loves a good time, AND BEER. Follow us on Instagram @BostonCrush.

name: Brassterisk
description: With one foot in the NOLA second line tradition, another in funky hip-hop crossovers, and the other in pop music detritus of the last few decades; Brassterisk transcends categories in the pursuit of a good time. Coming out of many different traditions, the players blend up into a tasty gumbo- a bit different each time, but always tasty.

name: Phoenix Freight Company
description: Jam-Forward & High Energy Roots-Rock & Americana @phoenixfrghtco.music

name: Clear Beer
description: c l e a r b e e r ?

name: Hot Cousin
description: Just a bunch of local musicians who formed a sick cover band exclusively for entertaining the masses during each year. Party so hard you forgot they were your cousin. You sicko.

name: Janey Bombay
description: Janey Bombay is a Boston-based jam band with a style matching a fusion between pop, jazz, and funk. Formed from connections of friends old and new, Janey Bombay comes to the stage with a fun, groovy, and up-beat energy and is always here for a good time. With a mix of covers and originals, they have performed at local events in the area for the past 2 years and are looking to continue with a first-time performance at Porchfest Somerville 2026.

name: Sam Reid and the Riot Act
description: Sam Reid and the Riot Act takes bluegrass in unexpected directions, crafting original and traditional songs with folk storytelling, rock energy, island sway, and American roots. Every show is full of the joyful unpredictability, familiar connection, and seasoned musicianship that defines their “unpure” sound.

name: DJ MISS LIP$
description: DJ MISS LIP$ is a local queer music lover and DJ ready to get the Somerville booties moving! We will be dancing all afternoon long with activities and remixes, throwbacks and pop hits. As a longtime Porchfest enthusiast, we are ready to put 28 Putt (28 Putnam Street) on the map!

name: Nickelbakst
description: Smooth jamming across the genres of rock, blues, soul, and funk. Enjoy the improvisational soundscapes with some of your favorite songs mixed with some of your soon-to-be favorites!

name: Avanza
description: Avanza takes contemporary pop and infuses it with traditional music influences from Spain, Latin America, and other parts of the world. We sing in multiple languages, including: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Arabic, Hindi, and more! We do this so as many people as possible can see themselves represented and share in our music. Our goal is to make a change in the Boston music scene by getting more people to fall in love with Spanish, Latin, and world music!

name: literally/nobody
description: Noise rock/shoegaze for fans of Sonic Youth, Unwound, Alex G, and Cocteau twins. Boston based. LP1, Saturn Bath, coming summer 2026. EP1, Candle, out now. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/literally_nobody____

name: J-Renee
description: Originally from Virginia Beach, VA, Jordan Brown (she/her, stage name J-Renee) is a fourth year doctoral candidate and performer of the practice at Harvard University. Playing with local Boston group “Jordan and the Boys” from 2022-2025, J-Renee has officially launched her live solo performance career in 2025 in Cambridge, MA. Backed by Oda Agboola on drums, Max Mitchell on bass/sax, and Corin Duey on guitar, J-Renee creates nostalgic alternative R&B music and debuts tunes from her upcoming solo album set for release in summer 2026.

name: The Accusations
description: The best songs, reinterpreted acoustical-ish-ly on cello, guitar, and keyboard. We cover songs ranging from 1964 (Beatles) to 2021 (Disney), but with an emphasis on the 1980s. Also a few original songs, parodies, and other surprises… Wayne Wylupski, guitar + vocals Stephen Peters, keyboard + vocals Alan deLespinasse, cello + vocals

name: Fai Laci
description: We are a five piece rock band who have been playing together for about 2 years. We are putting out our debut album in June and are releasing singles until then. We pull a lot of influence from Led Zep, the Doors, and Bowie. Hope to see y'all out there!

name: The Galvanics
description: The Galvanics blend classic-, grunge-, and 80s-era rock and pop, with a touch of psychedelia - playing covers and originals.

name: Radio Unfriendly
description: Formed in the heart of a musical renaissance, Radio Unfriendly is a power trio that thrives on the raw, unpolished spirit of 90s and 2000s heavy music. Comprising a dynamic lineup of seasoned musicians—each bringing their own flair to the mix—this band is not just about nostalgia; it's about redefining the boundaries of what cover music can be. With a name that nods to their choice of the less commercial, more audacious tracks, Radio Unfriendly is more than just a cover band—it's a tribute to the underdog hits of the rock & metal genres, a reminder of the rawness and the rebellion that shaped a generation. See them live to experience a slice of musical history that still resonates today

name: The Slow Down
description: Have funky fun good times with the Slow Down.

name: The Pinstripes
description: The Pinstripes are a band of singer songwriters including three singers, guitar, banjo and bass. We’re heaps of fun for the whole family and range from bluegrass to blues. Come on diwn

name: The Pow! Arrangers and Collective Measures
description: The Pow! Arrangers are a post-collegiate a cappella group located in the Somerville area. Catch us around the greater Boston area performing an ever-changing repertoire of classic tunes with a twist as well as some of your favorite contemporary hits!

name: Unusual Methods
description: We are a punk/grunge band, Somerville High School students. This is our second year playing Porchfest, we formed in 2024 playing more classic rock covers but then moved to more grunge music.

name: Major Grid
description: We are a new band based in Cambridge that plays a mix of covers and moody originals. This is our first ever public performance and we'd love your support!

name: The Timmy D Experience
description: Solo artist performing popular cover songs live on the piano! All your favorite hits from the 80's, 90's, 2000's, and today!

name: LaFauci
