description: We are a fun family friendly band that plays hooked filled originals with the occasional cover.

name: Blue Clouds
description: Blue Clouds is a contemporary/folk and indie band, with a sound that blends warm harmonies and acoustic rhythms. Performing a mix of original songs and covers, the band features Marcy Goldstein-Gelb, Martin Hunter, and Dana Lee on guitar and vocals, and Marty Brien on percussion.

name: the ams
description: popular music

name: Demolition Derby
description: Demolition Derby is a collection of friends playing whatever we feel like, mostly 90s alt-rock and indie. Like race cars in slow motion, come watch us pull off the chaos of the most eclectic set we could put together.

name: State Parque
description: We're a group of 4 friends who met at autumn house parties, started hanging out, and turned our common love of music into a surf-y, jazzy rock band that plays original tunes all around Boston for people to dance and feel to. We're now 3.5 years in, with dozens of gigs under our belt, a full studio album out, and always finding inspiration to try out new stuff! Follow us on insta: @stateparque; and Venmo tips to @Justin-Lengvarsky

name: Jennie and the Seagulls
description: Jennie and the Seagulls feature genre-hopping original music. From pop-punk anthems with hints of Letters to Cleo to more experimental rock songs with nods to Filter and Radio Head, soulful slower songs and even a bit of electro-dance, the Seagulls refuse to be boxed in. Guitarist Brian Joyce and vocalist Jennie Siegel co-write the music for this project. Brian’s rocking riffs, ripping solos, and atmospheric sounds scapes compliment Jennie’s lyrics and melodies which range from deeply personal to cheeky and playful. Powerhouse bassist Tommy Lada (of Ghosts of Jupiter) holds it all down. Expect a good time and take flight with Jennie and the Seagulls!

name: The Lucky 88s
description: We play an odd assortment of jangle-garage indie-bubblegum covers.

name: The Educators
description: We are educators who like to play indie-folk-alternative music.

name: mac&more
description: mac&more is a local foursome of musicians playing mostly rock cover songs from the 2000s through today - playing our 4th straight Somerville Porchfest. Andrew Mason McIntosh (featured) is a Somerville-based singer songwriter – specializing in pop/folk-inspired original music. He has performed at New England Americana Fest, Somerville Porchfest, and frequented open mic locations all around the Boston area. He has been featured in “Metronome” magazine and reviewed on the New England Americana Association website. He performs solo and with a full band as “mac&more”. His debut album “Water Come Down” is available on all streaming services.

name: Geoff Crosby
description: Geoff is a New Hampshire–based singer-songwriter whose music blends heartache and hope with poetic ease. Known for his warm stage presence and honest, unvarnished lyrics, Geoff delivers acoustic-driven songs that explore love, grief, resilience, and the messy beauty in between. His single, Who You Run With debuted this past July on WXRV (92.5) The River. Geoff’s freshman 2023 EP Leap features 5 heartfelt tracks that showcase his introspective style, built around a signature blend of vulnerability and storytelling. With influences rooted in alternative rock and Nashville folk, Geoff’s music resonates with fans seeking authenticity, connection, and just the right chord to crack open the heart.

name: Mailman Dan
description: Mailman Dan is a four-piece rock band who performs high energy and upbeat indie rock songs, playing a mix of covers and originals. First-class music delivered 7 days a week.

name: Buddy V's Black Wing Revue
description: "Americana with an edge" – roots music featuring original music as well as an eclectic mix of country, rock, blues, and folk covers.

name: Polar Vortex
description: Polar Vortex is an eight piece band featuring four horns and a full rhythm section. The band plays an uplifting assortment of jazz standards, big band tunes, latin and funk songs, and even the occasional dixieland cover or vocal feature! The band brings high energy to some unique arrangements of classic songs. Most of the band's gigs are at Porchfests in the greater Boston area - so don't miss this chance to see one of Boston's hottest eight piece big band cover bands! Polar Vortex is one of the weekly ensembles that plays at Music Maker Studios (formerly of Corey Hill, now located in the Brookline VFW - the site of the Post Underground).

name: Proper Degorham
description: Proper Degorham is a lightly seasoned Americana quintet serving up original covers of your aunt and uncle's ride-with-the-windows-down favorites. Don't let these self-taughts be all for naught – we have something for everyone and everything for someone.

name: Cliff & Carl
description: We play an eclectic mix of romantic/meditative instrumental arrangements from variety of traditions and genres, including movie themes, gospel/hymns/worship, classical, jazz, the American Songbook, Broadway, pop and holiday tunes.

name: Breed Hall
description: A group of friends from Tufts who've been playing together every Sunday for the past year. Inspired by Radiohead, Coldplay, and Fleetwood Mac, their sound is built around bass, guitar, keyboard, and Irish fiddle. They play for the love of it — and for the people Members: Marisa - keys/singer Payton - guitar/singer Cole - bass Will - guitar Mia - fiddle Shivam - guitar

name: 230 Productions
description: Vic Taylor and 230 Productions are back at PourchFest for the second year. Special guests to be announced one week before PorchFest!

name: Clever Hans
description: “The world’s most eclectic cover band”. You won’t see the next song coming.

name: Imagine Pigeons
description: We're a Somerville-based five-piece band of friends and family. We're all veteran musicians who are excited to finally be teaming up for PorchFest! We’ve put together a set of rock, pop, indie, and soul covers that are sure to get you moving.

name: What She Said
description: What She Said – Classic Rock, Post-Punk. You know – the good stuff

name: Rootie Toots
description: Husband and Wife musical duo, playing folky kids music for the whole family. And yeah, they are really good too!!

name: Jack of all Tracks
description: A alternative pop band of 12-year-old multi-instrumentalists, bringing big sound and even bigger energy with bass, piano, drums, and vocals. This is their first Porchfest. Come catch their debut set, punching well above their age.

name: Sara Devoe
description: Sara Devoe is an indie folk/rock artist based in Brooklyn, NY. Her music blends emotive storytelling with polished pop and indie influences. Known for her warm vocals and introspective lyrics, she crafts songs that explore themes of love, self-discovery, and personal growth. Her debut album, “Come away, O human child!” released October 31, 2025, and came with a sound that balances vulnerability and clarity. Devoe creates music that feels both intimate and relatable, connecting with listeners through honest expression and melodic simplicity.

name: The Revolution Will Not be Televised
description: A Soulful Jazz Sextet, with deep influences in Jazz, Funk, and World music, these musicians frequent the Lillypad, Bepob, Mad Monkfish, Post Underground, NEC and Berklee. Come hear tunes that are full of improvisation, with grooves that make your head nod and complete your relaxed Saturday afternoon vibe that is Porchfest.

name: SpaceLand
description: Spaceland is a guitar/bass/drum trio who play original rock songs with stretches of improvisation– or as we like to call it, American Space Rock. Fascinating trivia: Spaceland was the first band to sign up for the first Somerville Porchfest.

name: The Orrs
description: The Orrs are an indie rock band made up of Somerville resident Mike Thurston, Stefan Mraz, Reed Allen, and Noah Gibson. Their dynamic rock style is absolutely perfect for a late spring Porchfest day. They released their first album, As If I Ever Left, in 2021 after the pandemic on their indie record label Powder House Records. After gigs across New England and beyond, they released their long awaited and critically acclaimed self-titled album in 2024. Definitely check out huge fan favorites "Where'd You Go" and "Change Keys" from this album before their performance this year!

name: Toucan Jams
description: Just a guy playing keys and his friends who can actually sing!

name: The Fifth Season
description: Chelmsford based band playing classic rock covers and improvised jam sessions. We cover songs from The Grateful Dead, Pink Floyd, Goose, and more.

name: Untidy
description: We're childhood friends who have been writing music together for almost twenty years. Playing Porchfest since 2023 with mostly original songs and the odd cover of the Beatles, Dispatch, RHCP.... We sound kind of like if Green Day had gone to grad school 😉

name: Similar Jones
description: Similar Jones has been wowing audiences for years with a combined sound that’s bigger than their 7 voices. With a heavy focus on blues and rock, influenced by elements of soul, funk, and jazz, this high-energy vocal band uses a powerful rhythm section and bright background vocals to build the foundation for a wide variety of original songs and creative covers that truly capture the Similar Jones sound: one marked by tight harmonies, intricate rhythms, innovative arrangements, and -- most importantly -- a rock-solid groove.

name: Ruby Golden Tiger
description: Ruby Golden Tiger is a 14-year old bassist from Needham. At age 7, she begged to play her dad's electric bass and now collaborates with him who write original bass grooves, and recently started playing songs with her 8-year old sister Mabel who plays drums. Ruby continues to make her mark on the stage. She performed with nationally touring female bassist Blu DeTiger at the Royale in Boston, MA, and Karina Rykman at Soundcheck Studios in Pembroke, MA. Ruby has performed at the Needham Farmers Market, Hearth Pizzeria, and Brighton Music Hall with Girls Rock Camp. She was named a Rising Star from Markbass. Ruby’s musicianship and love for performing brings joy to all who watch her play.

name: Douglas Appleman
description: My name is Douglas Appleman, and I'm a singer-songwriter from Cambridge, Massachusetts. I make keyboard-driven pop and alternative music. I began releasing music as a solo artist in 2023, and have been performing locally in the Boston area since! I played in local Boston rock bands early on in my teenage years. By college, I decided to step away from performing for a couple of years to focus on my academics, but after realizing how much I missed it, I returned to music with a renewed fervor! I continued playing in local bands through 2022, including up-and-coming prog band Sunset Mission, before deciding to start releasing and performing music on my own!

name: Die Nacktschnecken
description: What would it sound like if the Misfits, the B52s, and Waxahatchee formed a coconut powered super group as a result of some sort of Gilligan’s Island situation? Come find out!

name: jack_slaw
description: we are jack_slaw. we are a band. we play music.

name: The Neopolitans
description: The Neopolitans is a teen garage band with members: Ella Lipcon (Lead Guitar/Vocals from Arlington), Greta Schuerman (Bass from Winchester), and Janey Wilde (Drums from Somerville). These young rockers perform original songs and covers of rock and indie music. They have been friends since early childhood and started playing together as a band after attending songwriting classes at a sleep away camp.

name: costume party
description: Hi we’re costume party!! A cover band in Somerville. We cover a mix of genres, singing songs by artists like Olivia Dean, Wet Leg, Consn Gray, and many more!! Come party w us!!

name: Emperor Norton's Stationary Marching Band
description: Raunchy circus roots. Polished precision performances. A joyful cacophony of Balkan, Klezmer and funk, with a tasteful thrash of metal thrown in for good measure. No matter the occasion, Emperor Norton’s Stationary Marching Band has got the brass to get you up and dancing. Some whisper in hushed tones that ENSMB is the ultimate herald of mirthful discord, while others have gone mad at the mere mention of the name. It’s music shrouded in mystery and wicked intrigue. But there’s one thing we know for sure: Dance! Party! Vibes! Better come see for yourself Horns will wail. Shoulders will shimmy. Faces will melt.

name: RONG
description: “Void of subtlety, the band carve into the impenetrable weight of society’s dissolution with a sound as brilliant as it is overtly chaotic. Sociopolitically minded but never heavy handed, there’s a definable rage found in their contextual carnage, but Rong don’t feel indebted to their indignation.” — Dan Goldin for Post-Trash

name: Tusken and the Raiders
description: Tusken and the Raiders is a high-energy indie rock act from Boston, MA. Formed as an eccentric 4-piece group for the 2024 Somerville Porchfest, Tusken has since expanded to six members, and is now known for their genre-mixing sets of originals and covers, their unmatched stage presence, and their ability to get a room dancing.

name: Crow Follow
description: Crow Follow’s shaman rock and urban cabaret brings glowing brightness to the darkest tunes. Risen from the vibe of a diverse and energetic music scene in Boston MA, Crow Follow celebrates and transcends it. Their DNA is from the Art Rock, Low Rock, and Post Punk scenes of the late 20th century, filtered through the usual smoldering warehouses and sketchy sugar shacks of the American Hinterland.

name: Ruin The Nite
description: EMERGING FROM THE ASHES OF FORMER ROCK & ROLL RUMBLE WINNERS GODDAMN DRACULAS, RUIN THE NITE WAS FORMED BY CHRIS DUGGAN (BASS) ALONGSIDE HIS BANDMATES JEFF “CHIP” NICOLAI (KEYBOARD) AND DAVE NORTON (DRUMS) WHILE HANGING AROUND THEIR ALLSTON PRACTICE SPACE TRYING TO FIGURE OUT WHAT COMES NEXT. ROUNDED OUT BY GUITARIST MATT SULLIVAN, TRUMPETER DAN MCCOOL AND SAXOPHONIST NATHAN BLASER THE SOUND AND STYLE TOUCHES ON ROCK, POP, YACHT ROCK, AND ‘70S AM GOLD TO NAME A FEW.

name: Bird Language
description: UPON FORMING IN 2015 IN ALLSTON MA, BIRD LANGUAGE SET OUT TO CREATE A SOUNDSCAPE AND ENVIRONMENT WHERE MELODY AND RHYTHM COULD FLOURISH OVER AND ABOVE SONG STRUCTURE AND LYRICS, AN EXPERIMENTATION IN CREATING EMOTION THROUGH A CERTAIN MUSICAL LANGUAGE. BIRD LANGUAGE’S EARLY WORKS WERE ROOTED IN THIS TYPE OF EXPERIMENTALISM, JAM SESSIONS THAT EXPOUNDED UPON LOOSE IDEAS, HOOKS, OR RIFFS, AND AN ETHOS THAT EVENTUALLY CRYSTALLIZED INTO WHERE THE BAND IS TODAY. OVER THE PAST FEW YEARS, THAT EXPERIMENTALISM HAS MADE ROOM FOR STORYTELLING, AND THE TWO PIECES COMPLEMENT EACH OTHER THROUGHOUT THE BAND’S DEBUT LP 625 DAYS RELEASED IN MAY 2022.

name: DIVORCE PARTY
description: WE'RE BREAKING UP WITH THE PATRIARCHY, and you're invited to the party! Whether you're finally setting a healthy boundary, saying bye-bye to a relationship that no longer serves you, or unsubscribing from a whole system of oppression, WE GOTCHU BOO. Transmute your disappointment, heartbreak, and pain into raucous laughter, rowdy cheers, and joyful jiggles as DIVORCE PARTY serves up original cabaret tunes with campy flair -- cheeky chansons, saucy bossanovas, uplifting anthems, and eviscerating earworms that put a bounce in your step and the color back in your cheeks. DIVORCE PARTY is the celebration of freedom, autonomy, and self-respect you never knew you needed!

name: The Word
description: The Word is a Beatles tribute band, formed by Beatles enthusiasts from theBoston area. The band's repertoire spans the Beatles catalog from 1963-1970--from early Mersey beat pop hits like "Please Please Me" and "I Feel Fine" to the prog-rock psychedelia of tunes like "Dear Prudence" and "The End." The Word is entering its third year, having played at porchfests, bars, and art venues around Boston. Video clips from past performances are available at: https://www.youtube.com/@TheWordBandBoston

name: Sammi Miammi
description: Sammi Miammi is a Boston-based drag performer and DJ bringing the Miami heat to the North East. Blending high-energy pop house, 2000s remixes, and club classics, Sammi delivers bold, high-impact sets that keep the dance floor moving. With a sound that’s both nostalgic and fresh, Sammi brings a fierce, unforgettable vibe to stages across the Boston scene. For PorchFest Sammi will be mixing a fun, engaging and dance focused set combining live elements from members of "Reservations at 8", a local rock band, for an unforgettable show.

name: Natalija
description: Natalija's recorded r&b melodies and electronic drum pads are converted to a live sound with a unique interpretation by her six person band. After returning from Montreal, she reconnected with the Boston scene to form a powerhouse collective. Joined by Moira Applebaum (keys), Jack Griffith (bass), Matt Pantanella (drums), and the dual-guitars of Cam Ferrey and Aleks Mijailovic, the group set out to expand upon the local musical landscape.

name: Coastwise Radio
description: Coastwise Radio formed in a living room in East Boston in 2023. Since then we’ve been building a collection of songs we love to play from the genres of bluegrass, folk, Americana, and country. Coastwise Radio has played in venues all over New England ranging from pubs to farmers markets to the Nantucket Light Ship in Boston Harbor.

name: Neighborhood Nine
description: Neighborhood Nine is a collaborative band that brings together artists from across the country, united by a shared passion for co-creation and musical exploration. Blending diverse influences, backgrounds, and perspectives, the group crafts a sound that is both dynamic and deeply connected. Their music reflects a commitment to authenticity, community, and creative freedom, evolving through each member’s unique sound. Whether performing live or recording, Neighborhood Nine channels the energy of collaboration into immersive, genre-fluid experiences that resonate with listeners and celebrate the power of making something meaningful together.

name: Gary Air
description: He's a dollar store troubadour

name: The Flakes
description: The Flakes make their debut, taking their sound out of the basement to the porch with a blend of Pop, Soul and Folk hits.

name: Jackson's Garden
description: Founded in 2018, Jackson's Garden has played all around New England, bringing a blend of psychedelic rock, funk, and progressive rock into their original music and cover selection. After many years of work, they are releasing their first album "Curious Creation" on Friday May 8th, 2026. Their debut single "My Son, The Leopard" precedes the album and is available to stream on all platforms now.

name: The Allston Rat Problem
description: Your favorite street pests play your favorite hits from the ‘90s and 2000s! If Alt 92.9 fm was your go-to radio station back in the day, then come on by!

name: HAMMERED SAINT
description: HAMMERED SAINT combines the strong musicianship of lifelong rock veterans and the chaotic antics of fearless frontwoman Emily Doran to deliver powerful music and unforgettable performances. A bracing storm of dark psych punk, and a few shout-along classics from the days of yore.

name: BayCity
description: An indie rock collab fronted by Boston native Graham Peck along with Steve Ruse, Chris Cornell and Ryan Silva. Bringing a 90's sensibility mixed with experimental and modern elements, BayCity's energetic tunes will get you moving

name: Full Powered Halo with Accoustic opening of Garret Tingle
description: Garret Tingle accoustic covers for 30 minute opening 3 piece original rock 1p-2p

name: Bell System and Pals
description: Weird Noises in various combinations from various sorts of technological devices, many of which involve plugging cables into things and the like. Improv! Experimental! The very strangest!

name: DJ Greenbean
description: Spinning house, disco, and feel-good vibes

name: Federal Holiday
description: Rock trio playing heavy psychedelic funk originals and select covers.

name: Senior Year
description: Senior Year has been playing together since 2019, blending dreamy synth tones with high-voltage guitar riffs across the New England region.

name: FIVE YEAR PLAN
description: BLUEGRASS/ FOLK/ IRISH COVERS AND ORIGINALS GUITARS, BANJOS, FIDDLES, AND BASS. SOMETIMES AN IRISH BAGPIPE.

name: BSB
description: We are BSB! We're a folk rock band covering songs from the 21st century, with a few tunes from the folk tradition thrown into the mix. Matthew Wallace – fiddle, vocals Sam Ratliff – accordion, vocals Dan Marten – bass Ethan Weiner – drums

name: SEMM
description: SEMM is an 11yr old girl band that plays the hottest pop song covers. This 3-girl trio loves to rock and have played at numerous Porchfests, Harvard Square, Kids Open Mic, and other local events.

name: Russell & Nair
description: Duo that specializes in Acoustic jazzy pop and Bollywood songs.

name: Quantum Moon
description: "Quantum Moon, a four piece outfit headed by local trumpeter Matt Kelly, isn't easily pinned to a genre. Fusing elements of free jazz, funk, rock, and more the band navigates deep waters and celestial planes while keeping a pulsing undercurrent of steady groove. The musicians set up a delicate interplay which leads to surprising and spontaneous moments that make each show unique. Keep an eye out and your ears open and you might get pulled into their orbit."

name: Adam Reczek
description: Organic, locally-grown New Hampshire folk rock.

name: Tonehendge/Dozens o' Bees
description: This electric grouping pairs acapella greatness and pop-rock instrumentals for a fantastic listen!

name: Crushdepth
description: Crushdepth is the musical project of Tony Basile, aided and abetted by collaborators such as George Philips, Pete Skerry, Ben Peirce, and Clay Arroco. What if Teenage Fanclub had a fiddle? What if Gillian Welch was some dude from Somerville? These are just a few of the important questions asked by Crushdepth. They've played around town at The Jungle, The Sil, Deep Cuts, O'Brien's, Notch, and other places you know and love. Tony also performs in the local group Aqua Hamster.

name: Harvard GSD Soundclub
description: snap swish click boom beep pop ding. Come enjoy a djing from the Harvard Graduate School of Designs Soundclub

name: we broke the weather
description: Proggy, jazzy, psychy rock. From the depths of Scott's basement.

name: The Vintage Mintys
description: Kinda rootsy, kinda swingy, kinda jammy, with subtle notes of twang and funk. Vintage sounds updated with a minty flavor.

name: Floor Time
description: Funky Cover band spanning all genres including indie, funk, disco, punk, and more!

name: Myopic Mystic
description: my·op·ic ˌmīˈäpik/ adjective .lacking imagination, foresight, or intellectual insight mys·tic ˈmistik noun .a person who claims to attain, or believes in the possibility of attaining, insight into mysteries transcending ordinary human knowledge, as by direct communication with the divine or immediate intuition in a state of spiritual ecstasy Grooves etc. Psychedelic rock with some touches of jazz fusion and improvisation

name: Better Sons/Daughters
description: Rilo Kiley cover band playing the best of the best early 2000s indie rock emo. Brought to you by Thought Partner ft. Daphne Blue Underworld and Tawny Frogmouth as Jenny Lewis.

name: The Elegies
description: Our sound is best described as jangle goth or the feelings you have while watching The Adventures of Pete & Pete.

name: Big Rav
description: Paramore and late punk inspired jams

name: Maple Tuesday
description: Nice to meet you. We’re an indie pop-folk band bringing nostalgic 2000s hits and modern favorites into warm, sing-along-able jam sessions. Come hang out!!

name: Cousin Walk
description: Cousin Walk is returning for its triumphant third PorchFest in a new location! The boyishly handsome and relentlessly fun duo is EXPANDED to four! Come join us for the first Cousin Walk performance with Somerville residents Bair Lambert and Zach Barnes. We're locked in and ready to have some fun with originals, covers spanning the 70s to songs that came out this year. Parker is really excited about his new amp, too, so make sure you tell him how good it sounds.

name: Ghost Truckers
description: The Ghost Truckers are a Roots Rock / Americana / Outlaw Country band that hails from Somerville and Cambridge MA. We play both original and covers songs at local venues in Cambridge and Somerville MA. They have been performing at Somerville Porchfest for more than 10 years. come on down and check us out!

name: Zach and Parker
description: Zach and Parker are two acoustic guitarists with an eclectic music taste. We'll be playing many instrumental Jazz/Bluegrass inspired tunes, including many covers of Julian Lage, Chris Eldridge, Tony Rice, and more! Expect lots of improv and guitarmonies (guitar harmonies).

name: Rose Street Recordings
description: Rock and roll band playing a variety of originals and covers! Check us out under "Rose Street Recordings" on Spotify!

name: Daddy Khaki
description: Easy listening/acoustic - covers only

name: Hot Start
description: We’re a group of twenty-somethings injecting fresh energy, grit, and youthful chaos into the Boston indie scene. Blending driving guitars with big room energy, we bring a live show built for anyone who craves the rush of real-deal indie rock. Catch us onstage as we tear into crowd-favorites from The Backseat Lovers, The Strokes, Mt. Joy, and more – all delivered with the electric spirit of a band that just loves to play.

name: Hoppers
description: Hoppers is a multi-city electronic music collective that *hops* between Denver, New York, and the Boston area for events that place a focus on unique locations and underground selections. We're pleased to be back in Somerville for what's quickly become a tradition for us: our 3rd Annual Porchfest Party. Running from 12PM onwards, our Hoppers residents (J. Bolivar, Techqui, & Rasaaq) will be bouncing between house, garage, latin breaks, and all flavors of dance music fit for the sunshine.

name: Madóc
description: Taking inspiration from her Pacific Northwest and Irish roots, Madóc is an artist who poetically blends the styles of folk and indie pop with Celtic storytelling. In the summer of 2023, Madóc taught herself to play guitar and by March 2024, she began performing her own songs locally in Boston. Since then, she released her debut EP 'Adrenaline Demos' and completed a 13-show West Coast tour with cousin and fellow musician, Sabelle. Madóc uses her powerful vocals and tender lyrics of self-care to create songs that bring listeners in. She is best known for her strikingly intimate yet explosive performances. Influences: The Cranberries, Maggie Rogers, Chappell Roan, Hozier

name: Mr. Rat's Petals
description: Acoustic? music for boogieing. Come say hi!

name: Fishtube
description: We are an indie pop band inspired by artists such as Phoebe Bridgers, Chappell Roan, and Olivia Rodrigo.

name: Playing with Fire
description: Hosted by jplicks.com/locations/f/Cambridge-~amp~-Somerville/24 Formed in 2023, Playing with Fire's wide range of music & electric live performances have made them a must-see cover band in NE. The groups' diverse repertoire includes original songs & covers from the likes of Amy Winehouse, The Beatles, Marvin Gaye, Radiohead, Fleetwood Mac, & others. Comprised of lead vocalist Liv Twomey, guitarist Karston Long, bassist Fedrick Blemur, & drummer Matt Brown, Playing with Fire has played everywhere from the Boston Conservatory of Music at Berklee, Drift Bar, Dwyer's Pub in Portsmouth, NH, Freddy's Bar in Brooklyn, NY, & numerous places in between.

name: Ohm Foam
description: Ohm Foam is instrumental psych rock from the depths of space, channeled through three humans from earth: Charlie Gargano (guitar/loops), Renee Goudreau (bass guitar/soundscapes), and Billy Leva (drums). The trio combines cosmic riffs with a planet-shaking rhythm section, moving from Can-influenced grooves to Sabbath-esque thunder, before finally blasting off with otherworldly improvisation, à la Pompeii-era Pink Floyd.

name: Galaxy Cake
description: Galaxy Cake is a far out sorta psychedelic alternative rock band out of Allston. Galaxy Cake is: Livvy Tailon on Vocals and Flute, Mollie Murnane on Guitar, Kristen Hughes on Drums, and Holly Kantor on Bass.

name: SUPERPINK
description: SUPERPINK. A band from the future. Music in the present! SUPERPINK is a band that defies genre, with musical influences rooted in french house, disco, funk, and punk rock. Show may include: guitar solos, cool sunglasses, and tight grooves. Pre-game porchfest by listening to SUPERPINK's latest EP release: Regular Songs.

name: Bae Blade Crusade
description: A group of bae bladers who are on a crusade to bring music to the world.

name: The Lights Out
description: High energy catchy modern rock

name: Winter Hillbillies
description: Cash to Leadbelly to John Denver with some Irish songs thrown in for good measure. We aim to have you singing along (and will provide lyric sheets).

name: House of the Century
description: House of the Century is a 90's influenced artsy post hardcore band from the Boston area comprised of ex-members of The Darker Hues, Red Quiet, Jeff Craley. Sounds like: Jawbox meets Fugazi meets Swervedriver, doing Blue Oyster Cult Covers.

name: Jetset
description: Jetset is a Boston-based rock band, playing an eclectic mix of original music and covers. Formed by four high school students, Jetset plays mainly indie rock music with energy and charisma.

name: Josh and the Wittness
description: Josh and the Wittness is a Rock 'N' Roll/Doo Wop group playing classic sounds heard on stages and sock hops of the 1950s and early 1960s. Every performance is invigorating, as lead vocalist Josh Witt leaves it all out on the stage every time he takes the mic. Josh and the Wittness has been performing in Greater Boston for nearly 8 years under different iterations, including a Doo Wop Acapella Group!

name: TimmyG
description: Hi, I'm TimmyG, a Boston-area Heavy EDM DJ, and I’m excited to be back for another year of PorchFest! This will be my sixth time playing, and I couldn’t be more excited. I’m really excited to be playing alongside ANEMOIA for the first time. After powering through the rain last year, I’m hoping for some sunshine and an even better vibe all around. In 2025, I released five singles and I’ve got even more music on the way in 2026. I’ve also been working on a ton of new remixes and mashups that I can’t wait to drop in this year’s set. Expect high energy, heavy bass, and plenty of tracks you’ll recognize and want to sing along to!

name: One Month Max
description: One Month Max started as weekly jams jumping around houses in Somerville and made it official for Porchfest. Our members – Matt, Nate, Ryan, Sam, Emma, and Berthy – come from diverse music backgrounds in jazz, classical, metal, and more, and hail from around the country, including three lifelong Massholes. Our setlist screams “I learned guitar in 2016, but things are better now.” We’ve got covers from every decade, so bring your mom. Bring your friend’s mom. Bring your mom’s friend’s mom.

name: Banjovillian
description: Banjovillian is a group of friends who play old-time (mostly American) music for fun. Banjo, fiddle, mandolin, guitar, and bass weave a joyful and unamplified sonic tapestry for relaxed listening and, perhaps, spontaneous dancing.

name: Soloonar
description: Soloonar plays original alt rock with songs telling stories about: random Wednesday nights, the pros and cons of human evolution, and getting punched in the face. We also cover alternative rock hits that were the soundtrack to our youth-think MVP Baseball 2005, Madden 06, and of course Guitar Hero. We've got a wild fanbase known as Soloonatic's led by Geena (our bassists cousin). We hope you (and your dogs) come to rock with us.

name: GLUTTY
description: iykyk

name: dayes
description: Teaching the periodic table by day, crafting feel good indie folk songs by night. Patrick Morelli started the indie folk project known as “dayes” in 2022 in Boston, MA. Patrick is a high school science teacher along with his wife, Camille, who teaches math and economics. The band is composed of the married couple and old high school friend, Pete. The music is inspired by Morelli's love for alternative rock bands, like Dispatch and Mt. Joy, combined with his love for folk artists such as Caamp and The Lumineers. The hope of this project is to remind the listeners that we're all in this together. dayes just released their debut album, Up on the Rooftops, in the fall of 2025.

name: PRETTY PANTHA
description: Uniquely a Somerville PorchFest creation dating back to 2013, Pretty Pantha explores the delicate balance of embracing the cozy familiar while finding new experiences on the other side of the stream. Rock, Punk, World, Psych, New Age, Indie, Alt, Jazz

name: Lunatic Neighbor
description: Lunatic Neighbor is a six-piece, funky party band whose top goal is to get y'all dancing and bring joy to the neighborhood! Our repertoire is vast and includes funk, soul, pop, and rock covers, some you'll know and some you never knew was a dance jam. We've played all over the Boston area, including local venues, like the Cantab Lounge, and larger community festivals and fundraisers. We truly love playing Somerville Porchfest and look forward to this every year. Come join us. Can't wait to dance in the street with you!

name: Julia Marcus
description: LET'S ROCK LETS ROCK today!

name: Nablus Road
description: Nablus Road is an original rock band playing songs for Palestine solidarity, anti-ICE protests, and protection of Mother Earth and our environment.

name: School of HONK
description: School of HONK is a radically inclusive brass band and all ages music school, powered by volunteer mentor musicians and popular dance tunes from around the world. Inspired by the spontaneous, collective imagination unleashed by our hometown HONK! Festival, as well as the rich and diverse post-colonial tradition of peoples’ brass bands, we take our moves and grooves to the streets every Sunday afternoon — to have fun, embolden our neighbors, and help band our community together. We cannot wait to bring our fun back to Somerville Porchfest, one of our favorite days of the year.

name: Ana Schon
description: noisy, sensitive indie-pop in spanish and english

name: Mixed G
description: We are a six piece feel good classic rock cover band based in Arlington. This will be our second porch fest in Somerville. Can’t wait to rock the streets!!!

name: Graham Sahagian and Pat Convery
description: Graham Sahagian (of Somerville) plays keyboard and sings, and Patrick Convery (of Boston's North End) plays guitar and also sings. Cool jams, skilled musicianship, eclectic song selection. May involve a drum machine or other electronic instruments.

name: Disquiet
description: Disquiet is a high energy 3 piece band blending atmosphere, melody, and intensity into a sound that is both immerse and emotionally raw. Fusing elements of alternative rock and indie rock. They move effortlessly between haunting verses and explosive, driving choruses. Their music explores tension, resilience, doubt, and hope, capturing the restless edge between chaos and clarity. Known for their powerful performances, Disquiet connects with the audience through authenticity, tight musicianship, and songs, that hit hard both sonically and emotionally. Disquiet continues to carve out their own space – honest, and unapologetically real.

name: The Spackles
description: The Spackles play short, catchy tunes in the pop/punk vein. We've been described as "prog-influenced proto-punk." We're not sure what that means, but it sure sounds fancy so we'll roll with that.

name: Ship of Fools & Friends
description: Just some fools jamming to the sounds of the Grateful Dead, Billy Strings, and more!

name: Hanchett
description: Covers of your favorite tunes! Brought to you by Trevor, Justin, Max, & Matt!

name: Krixus
description: If you love rock n roll then you’ll love Krixus. A raw, high energy, and loud performance with heavy riffs. Based out of Boston.

name: Regal Seagulls
description: We'll be playing instrumental jazz/funk covers of pop songs and video game music.

name: Ruby Grove
description: New England Music Award-nominated Boston-based band Ruby Grove (2023- now) is a 6-piece indie alternative band inspired by indie & alternative rock, psychedelic rock, trip-hop, soul, indietronica, and jazz-fusion influences. Focused on creating alternately funky, soulful & mystical atmospheres, the band delights in playing with genre in each of their songs. Boston music magazine If It’s Too Loud said of Ruby Grove, “Nothing else in the city [of Boston] sounds anything like Ruby Grove… almost impossibly infectious.” Ruby Grove is Melissa Nilles (vocals/keys/trumpet), Cedric Lamour (bass), Travis Rowland Jr. (drums), Josh Drawdy (guitar), Meredith Blankenship (flute), and Gabe Stillman (sax).

name: Yurrn
description: Yurrn is a dreamy indie rock duo blending hazy guitars, raw emotion, and purpose-driven lyrics—music that lingers somewhere between heartbreak and hope.

name: Tracy Jack Reed
description: Tracy Jack Reed is a Boston-based songwriter, singer, and bassist joined by talented friends/collaborators for Porchfest

name: Calcifer
description: Calcifer is a jazz/funk quintent that has been playing in the Boston area for 3 years. Our style is full of improvisation, bringing new twists to classic jazz standards and our own original music as well. Our debut EP is in the works! Instagram.com/calciferjazz

name: Tornado Hogan
description: Tornado Hogan is a vibrant new musical project led by Gonz Veloz, a Boston-based artist with roots in Venezuela. After years of working in creative direction, video production, and design for various bands and artists, Gonz was inspired by friends and collaborators to create Tornado Hogan. This project is about much more than just music; it reflects a journey through migration, multiculturalism, resilience, and the feelings that come from being far from home. In 2024, Gonz began writing songs that capture these experiences, all while developing a unique sound.

name: Jamaica Plain Honk Band
description: The mission of JP Honk is to be an open community group focused on the enjoyment of making music (mostly of the exuberant street-band style) for ourselves, for local community organizations, and for activist causes we believe in; and to be an organization with intentionally shared leadership that welcomes all and values diversity, inclusion, and transparency.

name: Fourth Dimension Tap Company
description: Fourth Dimension Tap Company was founded in 2022 with the mission to create, engage audiences, and extend the reach of tap dance through new works, collaborations, and performances. To expand the boundaries of what is expected. To present work that ignites the interest of experienced tap dancers as well as the general public and draws new audiences to the art form.

name: The Vibe Tribe and Friends
description: Your favorite pub band is back again for another Somerville PorchFest! Join us for a mix of covers you love and originals you'll want to hear again. Formed in 2023, The Vibe Tribe is no stranger to Teele Square after playing many shows at PJ Ryan's. Members of the band have also toured New England as part of Nomad and The Slow Train, a rock-reggae fusion band. Look for us at PJ's this summer and at Blue Ocean Music Hall in July!

name: Nearest Neighbor
description: Welcome to The Neighborhood! Starting as a jam session between coworkers, Nearest Neighbor solidified into a five-piece group with a sound rooted in soul, funk, indie rock, and pop. They made their live debut back in 2023, and continue to deliver high-energy sets that blend catchy originals and lovable covers. They have performed at local venues like Sonia, The Middle East, Cantab Lounge, and even Mercury Lounge in NYC. This year, for Porchfest, they're joined again by guest horns players, so be ready to dance, sing, and get funky!

name: The Shallows
description: Blending early and current shoegaze with a hint of 80s post-punk and new romantic, The Shallows, from Somerville MA delivery ethereal layered songs punctuated by sometimes haunting, sometimes soaring vocals and memorable hooks. Evolving in fits and starts since 2019, the band has found firm footing - releasing there first LP Wave States in 2023 followed by 2025's EP, Red Shift The Shallows are vocalist Jess Baggia (This Bliss), guitarist Brad Emerson (ex-Strangeways, The Milling Gowns), drummer Jason Keisch (ex-SCUBA, ex-Strangeways).

name: Situation Normal
description: Rock four-pack playing Millennial era throwbacks and a sprinkle of reimagined pop

name: Evan
description: Solo artist - mixture of folk and rock music

name: Alba And The Blizzards
description: Funk, Rock, Blues playing teens who formed at the East somerville community school and now are in their first year of high school. This will be their third porch fest

name: NP is (THE BLOB)
description: Psychedelic & experimental electronics & tape experiments

name: Pancho The Kidd
description: Gently psychedelic americana

name: Skaleton Crew
description: Skaleton Crew is a ska/punk/whatever band that writes songs about the spooky, supernatural, queerness, mental health, and neurodivergence. If you are looking for a spooky fun time, come out and join the crew!

name: DJ Close Chair, DJ G$V Ca$h Money, and DJ Mackhinator
description: You've never seen DJs have this much fun! Three musical stylings at one location: DJ Close Chair – A little bit of everything DJ G$V Cas$h Money – Afrobeats/Hiphop/Latin DJ Mackhinator – Gay club music they don't play at Club Cafe (but that they should!) And whatever else we feel like!

name: Standard Deviation
description: Jazz standards, folk, pop, bluegrass, Americana, a few originals. We're hard to categorize.

name: The Hopeless Romantics
description: The Hopeless Romantics are a Boston-based Pop Rock band delivering infectious melodies, rich harmonies, and undeniable energy. Fronted by Reid Kieper (lead vocals, guitar) with Drew Leuci (lead guitar), Colin McNamara (bass), and Sean Smith (drums). We aim to craft original music that blends a raw do-it-yourself indie spirit with exciting radio-ready hooks.

name: Saint Cecilia
description: Saint Cecilia is a rock band from Tufts University. Saint Cecilia was asked to play Coachella, but they declined so they could rehearse for Porchfest. Come by for great jams, classic covers, and brand new original music.

name: Muddy Ruckus with Barry Rothman
description: Muddy Ruckus is a "darkly inventive" rock duo according to the New York Music Daily. Guitarist Ryan Flaherty and drummer Erika Stahl of Portland, Maine play a grungy style of railroad indie punk blues. This stripped-down power-duo blends rootsy guitar and edgy percussion on a suitcase drum kit, and is known for a full rock band sound. They'll be joined by our local favorite, Barry Rothman, to round out the sound on turntables.

name: Eric Salt & Friends...with benefits
description: Eric Salt is a Boston-based songwriter known for his jangly, eclectic rock sound and memorable, well-crafted tunes. Salt has been a respected staple in the Boston rock scene since he helped found the legendary Abbey Lounge music scene in 1997. He has released 3 records with one of his bands, Eric Salt & The Electric City, all produced by award-winning producer Ed Valauskas at famed Q Division Studios in Somerville. His debut LP, “The Hail Mary,” was met with high praise, and “Please Say Yes,” his sophomore album, and a playful nod to one of his biggest influences, Billy Squier, helped earn him a place in the acclaimed 2016 Boston Rock & Roll Rumble in which he was a semi-finalist.

name: Fiddle Friendsy
description: We are a lively group of Boston-area friends who have been gathering for the past few years to play fiddle music together. Our repertoire draws from Celtic, Bluegrass, Old-time, Folk, Klezmer, Labor songs and more! We blend our variety of musical backgrounds into a sound that is full of love and community.

name: Jess Fulkerson Presents: Fulk Rock
description: Fulk Rock is an eclectic mix of traditional and original kids’ songs and hard rock/heavy metal covers, all presented in a simple, acoustic style ideal for early listeners and those with whom they rock. Led by Somerville-based music theorist and multi-instrumentalist Jess Fulkerson and featuring special guests, stories, and family-friendly lyrics, this joyously wholesome and wryly subversive program celebrates peace, animals, and nature.

name: Reward for Excellence
description: Our set consists of relaxed, melodic indie rock characterized by clean guitar arrangements and steady, low-key rhythms. We focus on a consistent, laid-back sound that prioritizes atmosphere and clear vocals. This performance is designed to provide a professional, easy-listening experience that remains at a comfortable volume for a residential setting.

name: SLAPPY PAPPY
description: Slappy Pappy is a four-piece rock band formed in 2026, blending original songs with select covers. Their sound draws from the melodic drive of Matchbox Twenty and the raw edge of The White Stripes, with a setlist that spans classic rock and 2000s rock. Pat fronts the band on vocals, songwriting, and guitar, with a vocal style reminiscent of John Mayer and Jack Johnson. Jake contributes lead guitar, songwriting, and backing vocals, Mike holds down bass, and Matt handles the drums.

name: Birds on Thursday
description: We're Birds on Thursday, a Boston-based 5-piece indie rock/blues band with a hint of funk. We have a few originals and some covers as well, ranging from Susan Tedeschi to Pinegrove to Led Zeppelin. Come hang!

name: Day Grazer
description: 4-piece alternative rock/indie band based in Allston

name: Hill House The Band & The Far Out
description: Hill House: Hill House is a Boston-based funk-pop band throwing full-blown dance parties disguised as live shows. We make our mark by taking funk, pop, & everything in between and turning it into something loud, rambunctious, & perfect for dancing the night away. https://bio.site/hillhouse The Far Out: The Far Out is a funk & soul-pop band from the north shore of Massachusetts. Known for engaging audiences with lush vocals & groovy horn lines, supported by undeniable chemistry & raw star quality, you’ll often catch the group switching roles mid-show – passing guitars around, moving from lead vocals to horn section, or stealing a moment behind the keys. https://bio.site/thefarout

name: The Cherry Pits and Viv Moda
description: 2-3PM The Cherry Pits - A group of 4 fun friends who play fun music. Our songs range from rock classics to childhood throwbacks to new age pop. Come join us for a great time. 3-4PM Viv Moda - We're a local rock/funk band, trying to break the boundaries of where genres meet

name: The Coe Street Co-Op
description: With a musical taste largely stemming from long road trips stuck in the back of the family station wagon with Dad controlling the radio, The Coe Street Co-Op is a squad of friends-turned-bandmates who like to kick back, drink some Gansett, and make beautiful tunes to share with beautiful people.

name: Weird Frenz
description: Weird Frenz in a new evolution of our musical style for old and new friends who love playing music together! We bring an infectious energy for our shows - playing a combination of catchy originals and covers with an indie/alternative flavor.

name: The Van Burens
description: The Van Burens are a family band of weirdos bringing the party worldwide and beyond since 2000. Come ride with us on the backroads of the galaxy.

name: Funk Safari
description: We are a Boston-based group that plays a blend of funk, rock, jazz, and R&B. We draw inspiration from a range of artists, both old and new, and perform original music and covers. The group consists of the Orlando cousins on vocals/sax (Joe) and keyboards (Dom), Josh Soper on guitar, John Krone on bass, and Nick Adair on drums. Outside of music, we are a medley of engineers and analysts that enjoy RuneScape, chess, and occasionally skiing together

name: Hot Take
description: A Cambridge-based cover band, playing all your favorite songs and more!

name: The Wickies
description: Rock and roll baby! And some other stuff

name: Mary Hail
description: Life affirming harmonies, chorus drenched guitar, eye watering saxophone. Do you yearn to yearn? Mary Hail beckons. Join us to commune in song. We will be joined by Somerville local band "Frameless," an alternative indie rock band.

name: Rat of the Year
description: Y2K Nostalgia

name: Wetware
description: An experiment in live jazzy/housy electronic music

name: Aardvark
description: **This is a resubmission of the application. We didn't correctly attach our videos to the first application. ** Aardvark is a Allston, MA–based indie rock cover band bringing sets of favorites from bands like The Killers, The Rolling Stones, The Backseat Lovers, The 1975, Radiohead, Red Hot Chili Peppers, and The Cure. We are 5 long time friends that have been playing music together for years and love to perform!

name: The ABCs
description: A local family band made up of three siblings and their dad. Audrey (12, guitar), Booker (12, bass), and Cora (14, drums) will be playing their favorite punk and rock covers. You'll enjoy songs by: Destroy Boys Mommy Long Legs Joy Again Bad Nerves Idles Billy Bragg Green Day and more!

name: Couch
description: After spending the fall on the road, Couch returns home to make their Somerville debut. Come for the horns and the wedding covers! For fans of Lake Street Dive, Lawrence, Sammy Rae, and Vulfpeck.

name: Louder Than Milk & Slow Boat Home
description: Original Americana act from the other side of the Charles, aka - Boston. Please come to hear us play our music, and dance if you have to.

name: Panic! At the T Stop
description: Panic! At the T Stop is a high-voltage, female-fronted cover band for anyone who still believes pop, punk, and rock peaked sometime between a flip phone and an iPod. Their setlist is packed with late-90s and 2000s anthems, with the occasional song from this decade thrown in to prove they’re still hip and paying attention. Expect loud guitars, big singalongs, nostalgic chaos, and unapologetically fun energy.

name: Anemoia
description: Anemoia is a Boston based alternative band crafting a distinctive murky pop sound that blends atmospheric guitars, emotional vocals, and cinematic songwriting. Drawing inspiration from across generations of alternative music, the band is quickly gaining attention for their striking debut releases “Anemoia” and “Enviro Maniac.”

name: Keeping Time
description: Keeping Time are a Somerville Tap Dancing Company. We will be jamming, doing some Improvisation and choreographed pieces throughout the time slot.

name: Nightjar
description: Nightjar is a trio of multi-instrumentalists with an eclectic mix of styles and a shared love for their mascot, Boris the cat. They are celebrating their third year together as a band, and are excited to debut new music at Porchfest.

name: Sun Salon
description: Sun Salon is a collective that brings together poets and musicians from a wide variety of backgrounds. Directed by Abe Brownell and based in Medford, MA, our performances are freely improvised, yet scaffolded by poetry.

name: Stuck on Static
description: Stuck on Static is an indie rock band based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, consisting of Isaac Maruyama, Becca Dunbaugh, Colin Allen, and Liam Obrochta.

name: Saklamara/Porchfest Project
description: Porchfest project/Saklamara has played Boston Porchfest on Springfield street for the past 5 years! They are a Boston-based world music band with an original and exciting blend of melodic and rhythmic sounds and styles – Eastern Mediterranean, funk, jazz, blues, and pop. We are both a listening and a danceable band. Our group includes vocals, bouzoukis, guitars, saxophone, keyboard, upright and electric bass, drums and other percussion.

name: Tony and Clio Flackett
description: Tony Flackett’s songs are short and to the point with music influenced by hip-hop, country and punk with lyrics that tend toward humorous essays on atypical subject matter. His influences include: Talking Heads, Tom Waits, Aimee Man, Public Enemy and The Minutemen. He uses a looping pedeal with an electronic finger drum to create backing beats on the fly for a full one-person-band sound. For this show he will be performing with his daughter Clio who is a talented singer songwriter in her own right and plays complex music influenced by the likes of Phoebe Bridgers, Adrian Lenker, Stevie Nicks and Clairo. #clio_songs

name: Hilltop Sunset
description: Hilltop Sunset combines poetic storytelling with the universal language of music to produce a unique form of understanding that elicits effortless empathy. His songs are intended not only to be heard, but listened to; each lyric is carefully crafted and set to catchy, accessible music to paint a picture greater than the sum of its parts. Personal stories of love, loss, politics, and self-improvement permeate his songs, which range from high-energy and emotional to slow and thoughtful to up-beat and playful.

name: Seibab Ssip
description: We play a mix of alternative rock.

name: Watson Park
description: Watson Park sits across from Merrimack, New Hampshire’s fire station, and less than a mile from the town’s high school. It’s also where bandmates Evan Joseph Ringle, Ryan Sinclair and Troy Hartmann spent much of their time while growing up together in southern New Hampshire. First a park, then a pair of friends recording songs together, then a band, the four-piece have performed throughout New Hampshire and Boston with the help of college friend Mik Jeromineck on bass guitar. In July 2024, Watson Park released their fourth record, Laurel, with their fifth record expected to be released in the Fall of 2026.

name: Shadows on the Mountain
description: Hosted by: washingtonstreet.squarespace.com Shadows on the Mountain is an acoustic duo that is inspired by artists such as John Denver, Iron and Wine, Brandi Carlile, and John Mayer. They started playing music together in 2019 and have loved performing at open mics, Porchfests, and events that benefit mental health support organizations. Particularly inspired by the music and lyrics of Gregory Alan Isakov and many talented local singer-songwriters, they've made the leap from playing cover music to working on their own songs.

name: Postmoral
description: Post punk band cranking out moody, gritty rock. Loud noises, louder feelings 🔥🎸. Check us out on Spotify and bandcamp! postmoral.band on insta!

name: MIK-E
description: Acoustic guitar covers.

name: Jack & The Offs
description: Jack & The Offs is for lovers! We are a pop-oriented, tambourine-forward, garage-rock quintet. Based in Portland, Maine we write music that is eclectic, energetic, and earnest. We are compelled by the spirit of rock and roll as well as by the spirits of friendship and heartache. Quotes from our fans: "Jack & The Offs is a perfect rock and roll band" "They sound like the B-52s, but somehow even sexier"

name: Three Weeks Notice
description: Electric violin alongside soulful vocals. Mix of indie, soul & alt rock, playing mostly originals (yeeaaah) with some jam tunes in the middle (right on right on). Come haang 🙂

name: Riches the Fish
description: your favorite fish

name: Rooftop Garden
description: 70s prog rock through a modern filter: odd time signatures, mandolin, trumpet, bluesy interludes, and a sound that's heavy, eclectic, and hard to pin down

name: Pluto's Return
description: Pluto’s Return is an emerging rock band comprised of seniors from Somerville High School, formed in early 2020. Our signature sound derives from strong roots in rock, combined with jazz, fusion, and blues influences. We play both covers and originals and have performed at a variety of Boston-area venues including The Burren, The Bebop, Redbones, and Sally O’Brien’s. This year we will be featuring our regular mix of crowd-pleasing covers as well as songs from our recently released album, "Slug", which is the culmination of our musical growth through years of playing together.

name: Phil and the Flying Leap
description: Phil and the Flying Leap twists and re-imagines music across multiple genres of classic American song spanning Vaudeville to Nashville to Somerville and everywhere in-between. Songwriter Phil Berman's melodies and lyrics usher the Great American Songbook into the 21st century, while lush arrangements and virtuosic musicianship from violinist Rachel Panitch and bassist Forrest Pettengill offer vibrant live performances full of heart, joy, and rich vocals. The group released their new string-layered single Spring Again on the vernal equinox, 2026.

name: Mostly Bones
description: Mostly Bones is a bold, Boston-based jazz fusion ensemble redefining brass-forward music with an unexpected twist: four trombones leading the charge. Backed by a powerhouse rhythm section—guitar, bass, and drums—Mostly Bones crafts an electrifying sound that bridges the groove-heavy textures of funk, the harmonic sophistication of jazz, and the fire of improvisational interplay. Formed by a collective of seasoned musicians and rising talents from Boston’s vibrant jazz scene, Mostly Bones fuses intricate horn arrangements with deep-pocket rhythm, creating a sound as rich in harmony as it is in soul.

name: Jazz Rats Trio
description: The Jazz Rats are back for this year’s PorchFest, this time in a leaner, tighter trio! We’ll be joined by a few special guests from the local music scene as we bring a fun, upbeat set to the Somerville Community Path. Stop by to hang out with us and enjoy a lively mix of familiar standards, modern tunes, and soulful improvisation.

name: Echo Bridge
description: Echo Bridge is focused on original acoustic music. Acoustic guitars, vocals, harmonica, great songs. That’s it. The sound is personal and emotional, with eclectic music tastes from the Beatles to Ray Charles, Neil Young to Bob Dylan, and beyond. These are the many influences that effect the songs they write and the way they sing. Jim McAuliffe sings, plays guitar, and harmonica. Gary D’Ercole sings, plays electric and acoustic guitar, and mandolin. Rob Emslie sings and plays keyboards, and Rich Gulden is on bass.

name: Missed Call
description: Camberville friends play jazz/funk/soul

name: Drug Deal Gone Rad
description: -Drug Deal Gone Rad is an experimental art rock band mixing the familiar art rock of decades past with an alluring blend of Goth, Garage, and DIY Punk Sounds. DDGR brings a hefty dose of focused rage and musical range. -Craig Robertson -DDGR is an art-punk band based in Lowell, MA. If there was a Mario Kart level based on Cormac McCarthy's "The Road", they would be the soundtrack. -Doug Sparks -DDGR is like if PJ Harvey and Iggy Pop have a baby and that baby is adopted by Sonic Youth and then they have to switch custody between Kim Gordon and Thurston Moore every other weekend. -Michael Dailey -I don't know, man…just come see us! -Angie Bruce

name: May Street Quintet
description: The May Street Quintet is a jazz ensemble featuring flute, saxophone, piano, guitar, bass, and drums. The group brings a fresh, expressive sound to jazz standards, spanning blues, swing, bossa nova, and funk.

name: Copilot
description: Copilot is a dynamically fun Rock-Pop band from Boston, MA that was formed in 2018. Maggie Hall, Ry McDonald, Jake Machell, Dylan Allwine, Austin Beveridge, and Jack Snow met between High School/College in Massachusetts and Vermont, often crossing paths while performing in their own musical projects. After coming together for an unplanned house party performance, the group decided to team up and ride together.

name: Muddy River Junction
description: Muddy River Junction is a five piece made up of Boston heads who just love to jam with one another. Expect the music of the Grateful Dead, Jerry Garcia Band, and other covers of the same ilk!

name: Currently Naught
description: Currently Naught is a three-piece band of best friends from high school that just never stopped jamming in their parents' basement. In addition to sharing their "college rock" originals, they bring a 90s rock and folk twist to some of your favorite 2000's pop and classic rock songs.

name: Lockstep
description: New Indie-pop group bringing good vibes and melodic tunes.

name: Come By This
description: Come By This is a Somerville-based cover band born of the passion for playing music in late 2025. With varying degrees of formal music experience, Emma, Guillermo, Ryan, and Sean tackle their favorite angsty pop-rock classics. Come By for their first performance at Somerville Porchfest and have some fun!

name: The Number Three
description: A genre-blurring band weaving alt-rock, psych rock, shoegaze, and trip-hop into a lush, immersive sound. Driven by dual male and female lead vocals with powerful, dynamic range, their pair experimental, texture-heavy guitars with hard-hitting, smashy drums. Mostly original material with a few playful covers, all reimagined through their distinct, atmospheric lens.

name: Cassie Kollman Quartet
description: Cassie Kollman is a jazz singer/songwriter, teaching artist, and bandleader in the Boston area. Her songwriting is introspective and emotionally nuanced, blending lyrical depth with harmonic complexity and vocal ambition to create a distinctive jazz-rock sound. She is a dedicated student of jazz, R&B, and blues, and she bridges these languages together through contemporary vocal improvisation, drawing elements from each style. The Porchfest quartet will feature Colby Sherwin on drumkit, Asa Fulton on keys, and Tony Leva on bass and looper pedals. With a shared language of improvisation, the quartet will explore contemporary arrangements of American popular music canon classics.

name: The Glow
description: Drawing inspiration from the good old days of soul, The Glow is staking its claim in the rapidly growing soul rival. Based in Quincy, MA, DJ Ormond and Adam McDermott showcase their unique songwriting capabilities through powerful vocals and intricate arrangements backed by a lively, perfectly versatile band. The Glow has proved they can keep up with the modern music scene by amassing over 300,000 followers across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube through their distinctive blend of comedy and music. Whether it's the raucous energy of their uptempo songs or their soft, heartfelt ballads, The Glow crafts melodies beyond their youth that they know you'll love.

name: Cloud Prescott
description: Samuel "Cloud" Prescott Mancini is an Allston-based vocalist, multi-instrumentalist, songwriter, and producer whose goal is to awaken the world with truly unique music. Refusing to be boxed into one genre, Cloud blends psychedelic and philosophical lyricism with avant garde indie-pop, R&B, funk, neo-soul, and hip-hop. His smooth falsetto, masterful vocal runs, infectious grooves, and electric stage presence raise the frequency in any room. A Berklee College of Music alum with over 400+ shows under his belt, Cloud channels the charisma of artists like Bruno Mars, Lucky Daye, Kendrick Lamar, Kanye, Anderson .Paak, and Tyler, the Creator while carving out a genre that’s entirely his own.

name: The Goobers
description: The Goobers are Sydney Lavoie and Jacob Baron, a couple in love and writing funky, weird, and heartfelt songs about anxiety, being stuck in traffic, and not knowing how to do good in the world. Jacob released his debut EP under the name Jabberbob last May, and has been performing as a singer songwriter in the Boston area for the past five years at venues such as the Cantab, the Lilypad, Midway Cafe, the Jungle, and more. Prior to the Goobers, Sydney has been writing songs and singing in bands and a cappella groups for multiple decades, and wrote, produced, and released an album in 2012. Jacob is a jazz pianist and has performed with jazz groups and in a wedding band throughout New England. B

name: Bahloul & Friends
description: Bahloul is a musician, poet, writer, and performance artist. He was born (Hussam Jefee-Bahloul) in Lattakia, Syria, in 1983, and currently lives in America. His debut album "Talassus Voyeur" (distributed by Realms Production) was released in June 2019. His first English book of poetry (The Chronicler of Indifference) was released in Spring 2019 in the US by Cervena Barva Press. His poems appeared in American poetry magazines, including Nixes Mate Review and Cathexis Northwest Press. He is the founder of project ta'sheeq which merges the elements of poetry/music/visual art together in multi-sensory performances. Bahloul will be joined by a variety of musicians!

name: Live Code Boston
description: Live Code Boston is a collective of live code artists in the Boston area who create music and visuals using code in real time. ~Lineup~ dm_radio + the.soup.of.the.night encrypted.whispers Sara Adkins + Adam Zeloof Teatro Grottesco sysfem.err BUNNY_KICK!

name: The Toucans
description: The Toucans are a group of brightly-colored tropical birds native to Central and South America.

name: The Fisticuffs
description: Rock and metal cover band playing songs from Queens of the Stone Age, CAKE, Black Sabbath, Smashing Pumpkins, Royal Blood, Arctic Monkeys and more

name: Spruce & Matt Lillie
description: Spruce, a rock band based in Boston, will be joined by Matt Lillie in one joint set. The two groups exemplify rock reminiscent of Oasis, Red Hot Chili Peppers, and Jimi Hendrix.

name: Alex & the People
description: Music for people trying to cope with these times | alexandthepeople.com

name: Mnemonist
description: Indie synth-rock trio, released their EP No More and Too Much in 2017. Keane meets Broken Social Scene meets Bedroom Pop. Debut LP Perfectly Honest Every Time will be out May 2026.

name: Lamb Rest
description: Lamb Rest is an alt rock/grunge band out of Tufts University. While mostly playing covers, they are interested in beginning to write some originals, drawing much inspiration from bands like Dinosaur Jr. and Stone Temple Pilots. Lamb Rest features friends & housemates Alex Lee (Guitar/Vocals), Sandro Carleton (Bass/Vocals), and Isaac Chomsky (Drums).

name: State of Nature
description: State of Nature blends kaleidoscopic psychedelia with heavy grooves and hypnotic jams. Formed in 2019, they’ve become a staple in Boston’s DIY scene, bringing high-energy performances to both intimate house shows and the main stage.

name: Leaf and Machine
description: Leaf and Machine are all over the map of psychedelic indie. The sounds scurry between folk, shoegaze, synthy slowcore, and Doors jams that never quite existed.

name: Regal Seagull
description: Alt-rock for the birds of Boston, and also Somerville. Regal Seagull has made a name for themselves in our local scene with 2024's Bad Robot EP, with their 90's inspired, energetic rock sound. Regal blends the energy of bands like the Strokes and Arctic Monkeys with grunge sensibilities, and are known for their live shows featuring their gritty, straight up sound, tight performances, bad jokes. In April 2026 they released Some Summer, the first single off their upcoming LP Mouth Sounds, and they release their follow up, Tomato Timer, on May 7 - celebrating their release at Porchfest.

name: All Bangers No Clangers
description: Unaccompanied singing with a powerful emotional register and choruses that are easy to grab onto.

name: Mel Starr & the Astral Projection
description: Mel Starr has amped up their music into a folk-rock performance any Big Thief fan would enjoy. One part twang, one part fuzzed out, moody guitar, two parts emo lyrics. Come sing along, sway and move to the bass, trumpet, drums and guitar in a lovely backyard during golden hour <3 the fairies will be out!

name: Warm-Blooded Mammal
description: We are a new band made up of three family members and one outsider that will play a lot of originals and a handful of pop-punk covers that will make millennial hearts sing!

name: The Last Second
description: The Last Second Band is a group of friends playing a mix of indie, pop, and nostalgic favorites. Located in the back property is a 45 minute set and a fun time!

name: Alive After Five
description: Somerville-based 90's/00's alt/grunge/punk rock cover band with a few classic rock and modern pop songs with a twist for good measure. High energy guilty pleasure Millennial anthem songs.

name: cedar
description: cedar is a four piece indie band bringing high energy, melodies that you can’t get out of your head, and always harmonies. Founded at Tufts University, cedar features college friends Ankitha Raman (vocals, bass), Harry Murphy (vocals, lead guitar), Molly Shafer (vocals, keys, guitar), and Ryan McLean (drums). They bring a set full of covers across a range of genres and decades, on top of a catalog of new originals.

name: Lenny's Funk Club
description: Lenny’s Funk Club is a nine-piece band based in Cambridge and Somerville, MA, formed in 2020 by friends who wanted to continue making music together during the COVID-19 pandemic. Lenny’s has evolved into a prominent local act, playing venues such as The Jungle and The Middle East Upstairs. Their music features expressive vocals, intricately layered arrangements, blistering solos, and a tasteful touch of goofiness. Underlying the infectious energy they bring to the stage are deep friendships that double as strong musical bonds, fostering an atmosphere of trust and camaraderie that can be felt at any Lenny’s show.

name: Stacy and the Party
description: Stacy and the Party is a rootsy rock-pop band with a mix of originals and covers. We are sending out some love! Come dance with us!

name: layzi
description: chill / showgaze / indie twang pop

name: Truckers Atlas
description: Truckers Atlas is a jangly, folksy, northeast emo band from Allston. We combine the best of Midwest emo, indie, folk, punk, and funk to create a sound all our own with a distinct New England edge. Our debut record, For People Like Us It Won't Last, is out on all streaming services and Bandcamp, and we have more music arriving later this year.

name: Nala on the Moon
description: Nala on the Moon has an indie-folk sound, but our lyrics are neo-Sufi. It was born out of a thesis project at Harvard Divinity School, which explored the relationship of the divine and queerness through the prism of Sufism.

name: DJs at Black Cat Labs, Presented by KiKi Co.
description: DJ Donuts, Chelita, Lenore, DJ Saucy Lady

name: Michael Reilly Peraza is That Guy
description: You know that guy in high school who showed up at parties with his acoustic guitar and sat in the corner with a rotating audience as they played 90s and 2000s favorites? That guy was Michael Reilly Peraza. Michael Reilly Peraza is That Guy. Back again for 2026! C'mon by! I'll be going through acoustic hits, mostly from the 90s and 2000s, and I'll be taking requests!

name: The Dotted Lines
description: The Dotted Lines are a Northern MA / Southern NH band playing indie rock, alt rock and classic rock. We mix covers you forgot you loved with original songs we’re hoping you’ll come to love.

name: Leviathan
description: Dreamy Hypnopop and a channeling of your deep inner power

name: Justin & Friends
description: Blues Rock, Dylan and Dead

name: Local Milk
description: Alt/Indie Rock from Salem Ma

name: Grapevine
description: We are a 3 piece indie/folk/pop band based in Somerville! We have a violin, banjo, guitar, and vocals. Expect to hear our takes on songs from bands like Big Thief, Caamp, some crowd favorites, and some originals!

name: items
description: "items" is the duo of Curtis and Doria Hughes, guitars and vocals, playing and singing original songs informed by prog, indie and folk-rock, with a hint of contemporary concert music and avant-jazz, as well as covers of songs they particularly like from the 60s through the 2000s, both obscure and not-so-obscure. On a normal day Curtis is a teacher and composer of chamber music, while Doria is a storyteller and art foundation administrator, but as “items” they impersonate a seasoned guitar-driven singer-songwriter duo of enigmatic and mercurial stylistic proclivities.

name: Erika Renée
description: I am a solo artist — a singer-songwriter who plays folk music at the intersection of folk, pop, broadway, and jazz.

name: Pat and Dank Play Music!
description: We're two great friends who have been playing music with each other for over 10 years and want to invite the public to come listen to us belt out classics, favorites, sing-a-longs, deep cuts, and maybe some originals. We're a couple of regular dudes singing regular tunes. Audience participation is mandatory.

name: Baker Thomas Band
description: The Baker Thomas Band is a ten-piece, feel-good groove machine serving up a mix of original music and crowd-favorite covers, built for dancing, listening, and everything in between. Known for their long-running weekly residency every Wednesday at Toad in Cambridge, they bring a rich, high-energy sound that’s equal parts tight and joyful. The band is also the feature of the upcoming documentary The Baker's Dozen, premiering May 19—so this Porchfest set is your chance to catch them up close before they hit the big screen.

name: mizz konduct
description: Check your manners at the door, come and see a local cover band playing punk, hard rock, and grunge covers with the occasional slow jam sprinkled in.

name: Viruette
description: THE GREATEST BAND OF ALL TIME

name: The Painted World w/Ben Hanson
description: Couple of guys who are good at music

name: Patrick Synan
description: Patrick Synan crafts music that blends the introspective storytelling of Noah Kahan with the smooth, melodic feel of John Mayer, built on warm acoustic tones and subtle electric layers. His songs explore growth, relationships, and self-discovery, delivered through an intimate vocal style that builds into quietly powerful choruses. Offstage, he’s a Melrose, MA local in his late 20s and a math teacher at East Boston High, bringing that same grounded, community-focused energy to his passion for performing at town-sponsored events.

name: Dr. Beaver 鬍子醫生 feat. Boston You and Me
description: We are Dr. Beaver 鬍子醫生, a 7-member Chinese band based in Somerville. Our set blends original songs with Mandarin covers, creating a vibrant cross-cultural experience. Our original music features a fresh, indie-folk style with light, nature-inspired tones, while our covers bring the dynamic energy of Mandarin rock. One of our original songs was recognized at the NCCU Golden Melody Awards, a university music competition in Taiwan. With 3 vocals, guitars, bass, keyboard, and percussion, our performances are lively, warm, and engaging—inviting audiences to discover Mandarin music in a fun, accessible, and community-centered way.

name: Dom the Composer
description: Dom the Composer is a Boston/Lowell based Haitian-American singer-songwriter with a mission: to make music with some rhythm, a little bit of blues, and a whole lotta soul. Starting his musical journey in the All Saints Choir of Men & Boys in Ashmont, Dom draws inspiration from these early beginnings & mixes elements from some of his current inspirations like Bill Withers, Daniel Caesar, Moonchild, Thirdstory, Jacob Collier & Lizzy McAlpine. He hopes to inspire vulnerability, joy, & self-reflection with every note & word he can.

name: One Lonely Meerkat
description: A pair of idiots

name: Solo Piper
description: Solo bagpiper

name: DJ BbyBrd
description: BbyBrd spins soulful symphonies of the funk throwback and disco groove persuasion. Easy to start dancing, impossible to stop.

name: Boston Liberation Center (BLC) Band
description: When we fight we sing! The BLC Band invites you to get out of your seat and stomp your feet to renditions of songs of struggle and hope that will fuel your soul. Composed of members of the Party for Socialism and Liberation, the BLC Band aims to bring energy and inspiration to the movement through songs that inspire our collective imagination for a better world.

name: Jane
description: Who is Jane???? An all female cover band hailing from Tufts University!!!! Come hear us cover a variety of genres and artists for Porchfest. The vibes will be amazing and awesome #pullup.

name: Entifan
description: Entifan creates with the intention of being a vessel, a channel, for love to flow out of. She incorporates a fluidity and soft power into her music in order to personally reflect and outwardly connect. They play with the duality of malleability and grand force through their experimental instrumentation and arrangements in order to evoke whatever will be evoked. What is meant to come up will come up. Her work is, to say the least, emotional. They treat their music as pillars of life-shaping memories, like leaving a trail of shells through a forest to have reminders of where you came from. Her music is not for the unwilling and certainly not for the non-reflective. Let yourself be a mirror

name: VO Extra Special
description: Vicky & Ophir sing songs & play guitar.

name: SG Stone
description: Sarah Greer Stone (SG Stone) is a rock artist born & raised in Greater Boston. A Berklee College of Music grad & Donner Music Artist, she’s an up-and-coming force to be reckoned with. Sarah’s voice is compared to artists like Alanis Morissette & Hayley Williams; her high-energy sets are inspired by bands like Foo Fighters & Fall Out Boy. With her storytelling approach to songwriting, years of operatic training & foundation in classical piano, Sarah has developed a style that is uniquely her own. To Sarah, creating music is like breathing air — something she can’t live without. She’s so grateful to perform for others & be joined by her INCREDIBLE band of friends/fellow Berklee alumni!!

name: Great Uncle Peter
description: Great Uncle Peter is an experimental post-rock outfit built of textures, grooves, poetry, and humans Abe, David, Adrian, and Kyle.

name: Brother Gabriel
description: Brother Gabriel is a blues rock duo formed in 2021. Former students at Berklee College of Music they have since toured the United States, and Europe and have amassed than two million streams across platforms.

name: Grape Slushies
description: Hi!! We are Matt, Em, and Carolyn, 3 people who jam sometimes 🙂

name: Bent Luck
description: Benet Luck is a scintillating Somerville-based pop punk/indie/emo trio playing high-energy original music from the heart. With EGOT nominee Rob on guitar, two-time Michelin-star recipient Yashan on bass, and high school cup-stacking champion Kyle on drums, Bent Luck is here to make a lot of noise, and then to convince you to listen to that noise over and over again.

name: Sing About that Elephant in the Room
description: We are “Sing About that Elephant in the Room”, we covers Chinese songs that are special——traditional styles, or talks about social issues. We would demonstrate traditional Chinese clothing and explain the meaning behind each song, and even made English version of some!! We believe music can reach our souls despite language barriers, cultural differences, and personal experiences. We wanna be seen, we want to be part of the community, we hope to not be invisible. We hope people can find resonance knowing other people at a faraway country are also fighting for a better world, and feel united!

name: Spicy Rangoons
description: My long time friend and I have been practicing guitar in the basement of our Somerville apartment for about a year now and we would love a chance to share our jam session of mostly classic rock covers.
